name: Adventures Online
lang: English
short: Tactical hex-grid fantasy RPG meets persistent multiplayer world. Six races, six classes, deep crafting, real-time exploration with shared or solo player shards. Free to play, free forever. No pay-to-win, ever.
about: Hex-grid combat. Persistent world. Always free.  Adventures Online is a free-to-play multiplayer online role-playing game built around tactical hex-grid combat and a shared persistent world. Create a hero from six races and six classes, fight turn-based battles where positioning and terrain matter more than raw stats, and shape a living world alongside other players in real time.   The game is and always will be free.  Optional cosmetic founder packs support development. No pay-to-win, no loot boxes, no virtual currency, no power gating.   Note: A free Adventures Online account is required to play.  You can create one right in the game. Native Steam sign-in is planned for a future update.  Features     Tactical hex-grid combat  — turn-based battles with spells, abilities, and positioning. Terrain and positioning actually matter.     6 races and 6 classes  — Human, Elf, Dwarf, Orc, Halfling, Gnome paired with Fighter, Warden, Thief, Ranger, Paladin, Wizard. Every combination plays differently.     Persistent shared world  — explore a real-time map populated by live players. Day/night cycles, roaming monsters, hidden ruins, instanced dungeons.     Deep crafting  — Smithing, Alchemy, Cooking, Enchanting, and more. Over 100 recipes. Crafted gear feeds back into hex-grid encounters.     Public and Private modes  — pick instanced private worlds or the live shared shard, on a per-character basis. Switch any time. Towns are always public and dungeons are always private.     Cross-platform  — play in any modern browser, or the Windows desktop client.    How we monetize  Adventures Online is operated by Adventures Online LLC, a small independent studio. The base game is free forever and contains every gameplay system. Optional cosmetic Founder Packs (Bronze, Silver, Gold) are planned as Steam DLC. They will give permanent visual flair: chat badges, character titles, walking particle effects, character auras, companion pets, and reserved character names. Cosmetics never affect gameplay outcomes, character power, or progression speed.  Active development  Adventures Online is in active development by an independent studio. The game is playable now and the world expands continuously. Always-online. An active server connection is required, so downtime or maintenance will affect availability. We post planned downtime notices in advance and a status banner in the game itself when servers go down.

name: Taskforge
lang: English, Spanish - Latin America, Portuguese - Brazil, Simplified Chinese, Russian
short: Taskforge is an idle RPG that lives in a floating strip on your desktop. Pixel heroes fight on their own while you work — you gear them, pick the party, spend their talents and choose where to farm. 5 acts, 3 difficulties, pets to hatch and loot with six rarities, rolled affixes and sockets.
about: A whole RPG in a strip on your desktop Taskforge doesn't run fullscreen. It lives in a borderless strip floating above whatever you're already doing — and inside it your heroes fight, die, level up and bring back loot while you work. It takes your desktop, not your attention Drag the strip anywhere: the position is saved per monitor. Pick one of three sizes and decide whether it stays on top. Found a good stage to farm? One click on the strip pins it. Closed the game? Your heroes keep earning gold and XP, your eggs keep hatching, and a summary tells you exactly what came in when you get back. Combat is automatic. The decisions are yours Nobody clicks attack, target or ability. You command four things, and that's where the game lives:    Gear  — which item goes on which hero    Party  — who's in and in what order, because whoever stands in front takes the hits    Talents  — where each level-up point goes    Where to farm  — which stage and which difficulty to repeat   Four heroes, three slots All available from the start — there's no recruiting, there's choosing. The  Guardian  is the only hero who can push damage reduction to 85%; everyone else tops out at 50%. The  Ranger  turns attack speed into damage from range. The  Arcanist  is the only one whose every blow hits two enemies. The  Cleric  heals the whole party as long as they're alive on the field. You start with one slot, and each of the first two bosses you defeat opens another. Changing the lineup has a price: a fallen hero can't be swapped out, and every swap puts both heroes on a one-minute cooldown. Three skill branches per hero Every level grants a talent point. Each hero has three branches — offense, defense and utility — and each one grants an active skill you shape point by point: cooldown, duration, targets, trigger. Twelve skills in all, from the Guardian's Iron Fury to the Cleric's Litany, and a keystone at the end of every branch. Skills fire on their own and play out on the strip, and the skill card always tells you, with your hero's current numbers, when it fires, on whom and what it does. You can respec — and it costs more the higher your level. Every hero wears their own set Six of the nine slots are class-locked — weapon, off-hand, chest, helm, gloves and boots — and the main stat of each piece comes from the class itself: the Guardian's helm and gloves are armor, the Ranger's buy critical chance and attack speed, the Arcanist's buy critical damage and raw damage, the Cleric's buy XP gain and item find. Only the three accessories move freely between heroes. A drop meant for someone else is never wasted: break it down and craft the piece you actually want. Loot that changes the sheet, not a power number Nine slots, 54 base items, six rarities and affixes with rolled values — what the item card says is exactly what lands on the hero's stats, and before you swap the card lists what you gain and what you lose. Two bases of the same type aren't the same thing: the focused piece concentrates the main stat and gives up an affix; the broad one keeps your options open. A Workshop for every item you keep — and every one you don't  Upgrade  up to +20, with the success chance shown before you click: a failed attempt costs gold, never the item.  Enchant  rerolls the value of one affix;  Transmute  rerolls them all.  Discard  breaks items down into shards or sells them for gold, and  Craft  turns shards into exactly the piece, rarity and level you're missing. Sockets and stones From Hard difficulty on, epic, legendary and mythic pieces can roll sockets. Stones drop from enemies with a random stat — or you craft the one your build needs, at a steep price. Combine seven to climb a tier. A socketed stone is permanent: it stays in the piece or it breaks. Pets hatched from eggs Enemies drop eggs in six rarities. Put them in the Nest and they hatch in real time — twenty minutes for a common egg, a full day for a mythic one — with a queue you arrange so the right egg hatch

name: Meowsic
lang: English**
short: You fell asleep. An orange cat has colonised your DAW soundtrack. Your real cat is mashing your keyboard. Your recycle bin is on fire, and the only way out is to make the music work. This is fine. This is Meowsic. A genre-bending rhythm platformer where the platforms are your audio loops.
about: You were supposed to finish your track tonight.   Instead, you dozed off at your desk. Your PC is still running. Your DAW (Digital Audio Workstation) is still open. And somehow, impossibly, there's a tiny, bopping orange cat with green headphones strutting across your soundtrack like it owns the place.  Your  actual  cat? Pink. Giving you that unsettling evil grin from right next to your Piano.   The only way out of this fever dream is to make the Meowsic.    🎛️ NOT YOUR AVERAGE PLATFORMER   Meowsic throws out the rulebook. Platforms here don't sit around waiting for you,  they're your audio loops , and you control where they go. Drag them, stack them, rearrange them to keep your cat moving forward. Every level is a song in progress, and you're composing it in real time.   🐱 ONE VERY UNUSUAL PROTAGONIST   Meet your orange cat, edgy, expressive, and physically questionable. This little guy can:    Bop and strut across your tracks     Stretch horizontally and vertically     Loop and spring through the air in ways that defy both gravity and feline biology             🎶 YOUR MUSIC IS THE STAGE   Audio loops double as your platforms. You're not just playing a level, you're arranging a track. Move the loops to build a path. Get your cat to the end. Feel like a musician and a gamer at the same time.           🐾 MEANWHILE, YOUR REAL CAT...   ...is right there. Pawing at your keyboard. Threatening to ruin everything. Use both hands to pet it back to sleep before it swats your progress into oblivion. It's a whole separate minigame and it is  exactly  as chaotic as it sounds.         ✨ Features     A one-of-a-kind hybrid of  rhythm game and platformer , where you move the platforms, not just the character    A stretchy, springy, loop-jumping orange cat protagonist with personality to spare    Real-time  audio loop manipulation  that doubles as both puzzle and stage design    A cheeky, fully realized desktop setting, complete with a burning recycle bin on the main menu    A live  pink cat distraction minigame  that will test your multitasking skills    Hand-crafted 2D art and animation    An original soundtrack composed specifically for gameplay    Charming SFX that make every bop, jump, and pat feel  just right        Developed by Scyte Studios Ltd   A small, passionate indie team that put a cat in a DAW and somehow made it work.

name: Journeybound Idle
lang: English
short: Another world needed a hero. It got you instead! A fantasy-idle RPG: climb the adventurer's guild from F-Rank to S-Rank, max your skills, clear 114 quests, discover 1,300+ items, hire companions, farm, craft, fight, and lots more! After S-Rank, Ascend to S+ and experience all new 100-150 content!
about: Another world needed a hero. It got you instead: no gear, no coin, starting from the bottom with an F-Rank stamp on your Adventurer's Guild License. Journeybound Idle is a fantasy idle RPG about the long climb from being a F-Rank rookie to an S-Rank legend, one log, one ore, and one monster at a time.   After completing all of the content in Origin, you will then be able to reach Ascension! An entirely new experience, not a typical idle game prestige, with new systems, skills, combat, and content! It is an entire hard-mode endgame awaiting you after your Origin journey is complete!    There are no cheat powers in this new life of yours. Chop, mine, fish, and forage across wild territories. Smith, cook, fletch, tailor, and brew what you gather into gear worth carrying. Work the task board, slay enemies, pass promotion exams, and earn your way into deadlier territories. Queue up work while you watch, or let the game run in the corner of your screen using the desktop widget while you live your life. The Guild keeps the ledger either way.            The Adventurer's Life     A Guild career from Rank F to Rank S.  This is not a small, or short, idle game. Seven ranks of tasks, milestones, and promotion exams, each opening new regions, gear, and enemies. Stories to experience, friends to meet, and a journey to a realm beyond your own.      17 skills to level.  Martial, Ranged, Incantation, and Fortitude carry you in combat. Grovecraft, Stonecraft, Tidecraft, and Wyldcraft supply your materials; Blacksmithing, Cooking, Fletching, Artisanry, Tailoring, Willbending, and Alchemy turn them into gear worth carrying. Round it out with a growing farmstead and the Sanctum, where offerings unlock a grid for discoverable relics and their bonuses.       165 monsters across 32 hunting grounds.  Your enemies will use combat styles as well. With the auto-battle style system, you will face all sorts of special attacks, ailments, and resistances. Tons of rare loot is waiting to be farmed and found!       8 dungeons.  Prove each promotion in the field, then face the endgame trials. You will be auto-eating your meals and auto-drinking a wide variety of potions to survive. Slot in up to five different unique abilities of the 32, many with varying ranks and ways to be unlocked. You will have plenty of strategizing to do if you want to maximize efficiency.       114 discovery quests.  A town of recurring characters with their own arcs, tavern rumors worth chasing, and a story that follows your whole career. Come to know many new friends! Help them, and see how they help you in return. Your story is your journey, and it will span from Hearthhome into realms unknown.      1,300+ items.  Weapons, armor, tools, potions, food, and boss relics, with a collection log tracking every last one. There are tons of unique and special items to discover in Journeybound. Each was designed with a purpose and use, ensuring a constant stream of upgrades as you progress.      Companions and a farmstead.  Hire companions, pay them an hourly gold wage for their assistance. The friends you make on your journey may also offer to help you gather and craft. Unlock slots and have up to three companions at a time! Your farmstead grows alongside you. Unlock new plots and ways to automate your farm, and plant crops that keep producing even while the game is closed.      An estate to claim.  Restore the Keep and awaken the Sanctum beneath for permanent power that carries the late game. A true stretch goal, the Keep's bonuses are balanced to be worth the investment.      A proper tavern.  Minigames & Music! Play dice, blackjack, and rune wheels while chopping trees or fighting goblins. Bet your accumulated gold, and see if you can hit the x5,000 jackpot on the rune wheels.      Desktop widget mode.  Shrink the whole game into a small always-on-top widget and let your adventurer work the edge of your screen. It will reflect the UI theme you choose, and display notifications for in-

name: Meowker: Desktop Cat Companion
lang: English, Simplified Chinese
short: This is a virtual cat on your computer desktop. It needs you to buy items for it. To buy these items, you need to earn coins by "working"—the game converts your detected keyboard keystrokes and mouse movement distance into corresponding coins. (no input information will be collected. )
about: This is a virtual cat that keeps you company on your computer desktop.  It needs you to buy items for it, feed it, give it water, clean up its waste, and play with it.  To buy these items, you need to earn coins by "working"—the game converts your detected keyboard keystrokes and mouse movement distance into corresponding coins. (Don't worry, no input information will be collected. Some systems may require you to enable certain permissions for tracking keyboard and mouse activity. For macOS users, please go to System Settings > Privacy & Security and allow Accessibility and Input Monitoring.) Input statistics are recorded every 24 hours. Seeing your daily computer activity may just be a nice achievement!   Public Cheat Code: Enter  makegold  on your keyboard in sequence during the game. A new interface will appear.While this interface is displayed, your gold coin acquisition rate will be increased by  1.5x .Additionally, you will receive  50 gold coins instantly  the first time you enter it each day.         This game features desktop pass-through, so you can use any desktop wallpaper as your cat's home. To this end, I've added a cat activity area setting and a restricted zones feature. Combined with the in-game furniture placement system, you can design a more comfortable space for your cat. (Try not to leave small gaps, as the cat or its toys may get stuck inside. If this happens, simply drag them out with your mouse.)  Hope you enjoy its company and have fun!   About This Game   This project helped me get through a difficult period to some extent. I poured my heart and soul into it to escape the troubles of other matters. As I'm not a professional programmer, I put in extra effort and focus, which may have left some flaws in the game. I hope you can understand if you encounter them, and please email me. Thank you again.

name: Your Daddy
lang: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Latin America, Norwegian, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Ukrainian, Finnish, Czech, Swedish, Kazakh
short: Need a father figure who actually stays? Your Daddy is a 3D desktop companion who’s always by your side, ready to support you, cheer you up, and never leave for bread.
about: Your Daddy  is a 3D desktop companion living right on your desktop.  Is your desktop feeling a little empty? Looking for a father figure who actually stays, supports you, and never leaves for bread?  Then Your Daddy is here for you.     He follows your mouse cursor and keeps you company right on your desktop. Customize him however you like, move him around, resize him, dress him up, put him in different poses, and make him dance whenever you want. Interact with him through right-click options and supportive text reactions, and choose whether he sees you as his son or daughter for a more personal fatherly experience.    Features:  • 3D desktop companion living on your desktop • Follows your mouse cursor • Move, rotate, and scale the character • Change outfits and customize his look • Set different poses • Activate dances and idle animations • Right-click interaction menu • Supportive text reactions • Choose whether you’re his son or daughter    Content:  • Your Daddy character • Multiple customization options • Different poses, dances, and desktop interactions

name: KeyQu
lang: English
short: Turn your keyboard into a customizable desktop companion! Map your favorite sounds, images, and gifs to keys, use built-in presets, or create your own reactions for a setup that's uniquely yours.
about: Your keyboard. Your sounds. Your companion. Your rules.   What if every key you pressed could bring something to life on your desktop?  A dog that barks. A cat that reacts. A robot that beeps.  KeyQu  is a customizable desktop companion that turns your keyboard into a playground of sounds and visual reactions.  Start With a Companion  Jump straight into the fun with built-in presets like  Lol woof bark ,  Cat! , and  Robo . Pick a companion and make it part of your setup.  Your Imagination, Your Rules  Use images, animated GIFs, and sounds to create personalized reactions and map them to the keys you choose.  Cute companions? Favorite characters? Chaotic memes and ridiculous sound effects?   Why stick to someone else's idea of what a desktop companion should be?   Make it cute, weird, chaotic, or completely absurd. Your companion, your creativity.  Create. Customize. Share.  Move KeyQu around your desktop or onto another monitor. Customize your keyboard-triggered reactions, then share your creations and discover community-made content through  Steam Workshop .   KeyQu — Your keys. Your reactions.

name: SideQuest
lang: English
short: A desktop game designed to help you focus on real world tasks. Featuring a hat collection, different locations, romantic stories, and a built-in system clock.
about: Start your SideQuest so you can focus on your main quest. A desktop game designed to help you focus on what really matters such as homework, projects, work, or even another game.           Key Features     Desktop Companion:  Designed as a lightweight desktop companion, the game sits on the side of your screen.     Idle Platformer : There are no controls. Your progress is tied to your real world focus.     100 Hats to Collect:  Every 25 minutes of focus earns you a new hat to add to your collection.     Simple Romantic Tales:  Uncover light romantic story moments and multiple endings tied to your long term focus.     System Clock:  Keep an eye on real time with a clean integrated system clock.

name: Emu
lang: English
short: Emu - your desktop pet / audio visualisation
about: Emu  is a desktop companion who follows your mouse around, judges you and uses it's cubic brainwaves to visualise sounds that leave your computer.        Click on him to change his colour. Right click to change his pattern. Select him and then use arrow keys to move him around.

name: Baibai: The Desk Fish
lang: English, Simplified Chinese
short: You can't always take a break, but Baibai can do it for you. Meet a little fish coworker who lives on your desktop, drifts off, takes it easy, and keeps you company. Click to interact, change outfits, and uncover stories together.
about: You may have to keep working, but Baibai can take it easy for you.  Baibai: The Desk Fish is a light desktop companion game. A whale, tuna, or shark settles into a corner of your screen, drifting off, getting sleepy, and sometimes heading to the beach for a breather. You don't have to look after your fish constantly. A glance or a click between tasks can reveal a new action or conversation.  Spend time together and you'll gradually get to know each other. Collect little pieces of “slacking evidence,” experience relationship events, and watch your fish coworker find its own rhythm in an overly serious office world.  • Three fish coworkers with distinct personalities and nine interchangeable outfits.  • Desktop interactions, autonomous behavior, beach and underwater scenes, and nine short theater stories.  • Relationship events, 25 collectible evidence items, and 25 achievements to unlock over time.  • Photo and sharing tools: choose a pose, direction, and position, then export a transparent character image or share card.  • Local saves, backup, and privacy deletion. No productivity score or precise absence tracking.  Baibai isn't a Pomodoro timer, and it won't chase your to-do list. It's a little desktop companion happy to take a breath with you.

name: Milly's Meadow Demo
lang: English
short: A relaxing idle game that lives on your desktop. Watch Milly tend to her meadow by raking leaves, taking cozy naps, and enjoying a peaceful life. Enjoy the calming ambience right on your screen, whether you’re working or unwinding.
about: Milly’s Meadow (Demo) is a relaxing idle game that sits on your desktop - resize it and place it anywhere to create the perfect peaceful backdrop for your day. Enjoy the soothing sounds of nature, raking leaves and original lo-fi tunes.                This demo is a minimal version of the base game - and you're welcome to enjoy it forever as a relaxing desktop companion. Keep it on top or behind your favourite apps so you can check in on Milly anytime.  If you'd like to unlock customisation for Milly and her meadow, add new activities like Fishing and Farming, or adjust activity durations, check out the full version.

name: Chichi's Desktop Journey
lang: English*, French*, Italian*, Spanish - Spain*, Danish*, Indonesian*, Japanese*, Thai*, Simplified Chinese*, Traditional Chinese*, Korean*, German*, Ukrainian*, Russian*, Turkish*, Czech*, Polish*, Swedish*, Dutch*, Portuguese - Brazil*, Portuguese - Portugal*, Bulgarian*, Hungarian*, Greek*, Norwegian*, Spanish - Latin America*, Vietnamese*, Malay*, Romanian*, Finnish**
short: Welcome to chichi’s world! Chichi is a little mouse with big travel dreams and just one piece of luggage: a ball! Keep chichi company while you work or study, play together, try new outfits and skins, or go online with friends and bring your mice together on your desktops.
about: A desktop companion simulation game designed to keep you company while you work or study. Key features:     Low-Distraction Design:  The mouse only scurries along the edges of your screen, keeping your workspace clear. lang: English*, Simplified Chinese**
short: Fish Tankfully is a desktop idle aquarium sim that blends relaxing fishkeeping with a realistic ecosystem. Raise 200 ornamental fish, build tanks with plants, driftwood and gear, and manage lighting, filtration, stocking and compatibility with ease, even as a beginner.
about: Welcome, fish keepers, to  Fish Tankfully ! This is a desktop idle aquarium simulation game that balances laid-back, relaxing idle viewing with a realistic and meticulous tank ecosystem. Whether you're a fishkeeping enthusiast, an office worker sneaking in some downtime, or even a hardcore aquarist,  Fish Tankfully  is just the perfect tank to give you a cozy, easygoing escape.      A Rich Ecosystem!    200 species of ornamental fish, over a hundred varieties of aquatic plants and driftwood, dozens of pieces of equipment and gear, and more than a dozen tank styles — all within your very own tank! Players are free to plan and cultivate their aquarium however they please — from native local fish to South American tropicals, from planted nano tanks to native biotope streams. In real life you have to choose; in cyber fishkeeping, I want it all!      A True Fish Nerd's Paradise!    A faithful simulation of a real aquarium environment — from lighting to filtration, from stocking density to carbon and oxygen levels, from fish compatibility to wild catching — every aspect of fishkeeping is authentically recreated here. But newcomers needn't feel any pressure at all — as the saying goes, every water suits its own fish. A relaxed, easygoing experience is the principle  Fish Tankfully  sticks to. Every fish nerd will find themselves smiling knowingly and happily watching their fish here.         Built on Love!    Our dev team is a mix of industry veterans from big studios and fresh-faced new grads. Some of us grew tired of the flashiness of commercial games, some grew tired of elevator commutes and PowerPoint presentations, and some grew tired of trading 996 for a year-end bonus. So we pitched a project here, and set up three fish tanks. Making games while keeping fish, we became true fishkeepers — and untethered game makers. What we wanted turned into a little patch of freedom, a tankful of happy water. In this tank there's no scheming, no microtransactions, no traps — there's the rough-and-tumble authenticity of a wild-caught biotope tank, the shimmering delicacy of a nano planted tank, and tank after tank of boundless love for games.       So — happy fishkeeping, happy gaming. May you enjoy your game, and may everything be  just enough .

about: An adventure in the corner of your desktop Alice's Desktop Adventure is a pixel-art RPG centered on single-player idle play, designed to run in the corner of your desktop. Alice advances automatically, fights monsters, and collects drops while you work, watch videos, or do other things. Idle battles may also drop outfits. name: Desktop Charging Station
lang: English, Simplified Chinese, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Japanese, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Korean
short: Run an idle solar charging station on your desktop. Idle power generation and charging continue while you work or study. Manually sell fully charged products; partially charged products stay. Reinvest coins in new products, better equipment, and more rooms.
about: Run an idle solar charging station on your desktop Desktop Charging Station is a relaxing idle management game along the bottom of your desktop. Set up your equipment and let the station idle, generate power, and charge products automatically. Let products charge while you work, study, or do something else, then return to manually sell fully charged products and grow your station.      Idle power, automatic charging, manual sales Install rooftop solar panels, energy storage, and charging equipment. All rooms share power without wiring. You choose when to manually sell fully charged products. Only fully charged products are sold; partially charged products are kept. While the game stays running, your station keeps working unattended, even with the interface collapsed, another app in focus, or you away from the computer. Earn, reinvest, and expand your power station Reinvest your manual sales income in new products, stronger solar panels, more storage, extra charging slots, and additional rooms. Progress from small cells to vehicle battery packs and large energy-storage products in a satisfying loop: produce, sell manually, earn, and expand. Grow to up to ten rooms and scroll sideways to explore your expanding station and rooftops.      Build your business and launch your ship Research ship technology along three routes: generation power, storage capacity and product value. Each completed stage unlocks more valuable products. Finish all three routes to launch your ship for the journey home, then stay at the station and keep expanding.      Check in at your own pace Expand the station for a quick look between tasks, then collapse it while production continues. The game sits on the desktop layer, beneath ordinary application windows. Solar output stays steady regardless of real-world daylight. Production does not accumulate while the game is closed or your computer is asleep or hibernating.

name: AquaDesk - Desktop Aquarium
lang: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil, Polish, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean
short: AquaDesk - Desktop Aquarium is a relaxing aquarium simulation that turns your desktop into a living home for tropical fish. Feed, care for, breed, and discover unique fish through genetics and unlock new features as your calm desktop aquarium grows.
about: Your desktop becomes a little aquarium.    AquaDesk - Desktop Aquarium is a life-sim game that turns your desktop into a small aquarium with tropical fish swimming through it.  The fish swim freely across your screen, offering a calm underwater view in the odd moment between tasks. It aims to be a desktop-resident aquarium experience: soothing just to watch, and rewarding to raise little by little while it idles.    You feed your fish and change their water as you raise them.  Every fish inherits colour and pattern factors from its parents, so a rare youngster can suddenly appear from two ordinary-looking parents. What shows up is not limited to real-world colours like albino — colours and patterns no real tropical fish has are far from rare here. Enjoy discovering what turns up, and build an aquarium that is yours alone.    As you progress, the skill tree unlocks new features. Conveniences for looking after the tank, touches that make the aquarium more beautiful, ways to deepen your bond with the fish — what you can do grows steadily to match how you play.  A joy to watch. A joy to raise. Always changing a little, even while you leave it alone.  AquaDesk brings a quiet, beautiful, living tank to your desktop.    The fish you'll meet     Neon tetra  — A glowing blue neon stripe over a red body. A little shoaling fish, and the first one you'll welcome.     Bronze corydoras  — A gentle catfish that bustles along the tank floor. Earns its keep as a cleanup crew, eating leftover food.     White Cloud Mountain minnow  — Bright red fins and a famously tough constitution. The perfect beginner's fish.     Freshwater angelfish  — A tall, elegant silhouette. Pairs for life with a chosen mate and guards the eggs together.     Rummy-nose tetra  — A blazing red nose and black-and-white bars on the tail. Shoals extremely tightly, wheeling all at once.     Black phantom tetra  — A black diamond patch, and large black fins on the males. Rival males square off with fins spread wide.     Platy  — A livebearer that gives birth to free-swimming fry instead of laying eggs. Crossbreeding brings out a variety of markings.     Glass catfish  — A curious catfish with a body as clear as glass. Schools hover gently in mid-water, all facing the same way.    Fish join you once you unlock them in the Skill tree or the SP Shop. More will be added in future updates.  Key features  • A living aquarium of tropical fish swimming across your desktop  • Fish from the neon tetra to the glass catfish, each with its own temperament and way of swimming  • A wallpaper mode that doubles as a living wallpaper  • A raising sim of feeding, water changes and breeding  • A genetics system that gives even fish of the same species different personalities and traits  • A collection of colours, patterns and combinations that go well beyond albino — ones no real fish has  • Feature unlocks through the skill tree  • Designed to enjoy while you work, or to progress as an idle game  • Build a quiet desktop aquarium that is yours alone

name: 等一个蛋 / Waiting for an Egg

short: A pixel-art idle companion about focus and patience. Raise 8 chicken breeds, wait through review cycles, collect five tiers of Inspiration Eggs, expand your coop, and decorate your farm. Includes a focus timer, saved sticky notes, and a movable, resizable desktop window.
about: Waiting for an Egg is a pixel-art idle companion about focus, patience, and the long wait for results.   Welcome to the Inspiration Farm. Your chickens enter long review cycles and grind for inspiration on their own. When luck is on your side, they lay an Inspiration Egg. Collect it for Funding, expand the coop, unlock breeds, and shape a desktop farm of your own.  Each chicken has limited inspiration and eventually retires. Choose breeds with different cycle times and result odds to set the pace of your wait.                 Core Features     8 Chicken Breeds  Each breed has a different review-cycle length and result chance. Choose a pace that suits you and collect them over time.     5 Result Tiers  Inspiration Eggs range from Q4 to TOP across five tiers, each with a different value.     Expand Your Coop  Begin with room for three chickens, then spend Funding to increase capacity.                 Focus Timer  Use the built-in Pomodoro timer to manage real-world focus sessions and earn extra Funding.     Saved Sticky Notes  Keep tasks and sudden ideas close at hand, then move each note where it fits.     Decorate Your Farm  Unlock a variety of decorations with Funding, then zoom and pan around your farm.     Adjustable Desktop Window  Move and resize the game window. The interface scales with the window to fit different desktop layouts.          A game about patience and output. Let it idle, and may your results arrive soon.

name: SUPER IDLE POOP CLICKER
lang: English
short: A goofy idle clicker about clicking poop and collecting farts, buying upgrades, and watching numbers get absolutely out of control.
about: Super Idle Poop Clicker  is a goofy idle clicker game about clicking poop and watching numbers go up.  You start with manual clicks. Clicking earns XP and farts, which you spend on upgrades. Those upgrades increase click power, add idle income, unlock automation, and push the game toward playing itself.  As you progress, you unlock new poop tiers. Each tier increases the difficulty in leveling up. When things slow down, you can prestige to start over with permanent boosts and climb even quicker the next run.  This is a classic idle game at heart. There’s no story, no time pressure, and no skill requirements. You can actively click, leave it running in the background, or check in occasionally to buy upgrades and move on.  Despite the name, the game is fully cartoony and non-explicit. The theme is silly on purpose, but the progression systems are solid and familiar for fans of idle and incremental games.  If you like watching systems snowball, numbers spiral upward, and efficiency slowly get out of control, this game delivers exactly that, just with poop.  Features    Clicker and idle gameplay that ramps into full automation    Thirty poop tiers that effect progression    Prestige system with permanent bonuses    Designed for short sessions or background play    Clean, cartoony visuals with light humor    Many hilarious, awkward, and disgusting fart noises      This game is designed to run in  portrait (vertical) orientation only . It plays in a vertical window and does  not support fullscreen . This is intentional and helps keep the UI readable and the gameplay comfortable for idle play. The game runs perfectly in windowed mode on desktop monitors.

name: The Idle Captain
lang: English
short: A pirate idle RPG that runs as an overlay on your desktop. Sail between locations, fish, craft goods, brew, trade at the marketplace, and battle enemies while leveling up fishing, combat, and sailing skills in the background.
about: The Idle Captain is a pirate idle RPG that runs as a transparent overlay on your Windows desktop. Your captain fishes, fights, crafts and trades while you go about your day.       Set sail from your home port and travel to new locations across the ocean. Each destination opens up new activities, tougher enemies, and better rewards. The more you sail, the faster you get there.  The Idle Captain lives on your desktop without getting in the way. Drag it wherever you like, resize it to fit your setup, and let your captain get to work.          Most of your early time is spent fishing. Start at the local pond and unlock better spots as your fishing level climbs. Occasionally a special bite pops up, a quick mini-game that gives you a shot at catching something you wouldn't normally find.          When you're ready for a fight, take on various different enemies. Your attack, defense and vitality skills all grow through combat, making each fight more rewarding than the last.       Back at port you can put your catches to good use. Cook up fresh fish, brew some wine, or craft goods at the workbench. Most crafted items sell for a lot more than the raw stuff, so it's worth taking the time to craft before you sell.       The marketplace stocks a rotating selection of ingredients and goods. Buy low, craft smart, sell high. Stock changes regularly so there is always something worth picking up.       Skills grow as you play, Fishing, Attack, Defense, Vitality, Crafting and Sailing. Higher levels unlock new areas, stronger enemies and better loot.

about: Virsamals Companion Console is a retro game console for your desktop. You and your chosen companion go on idle adventures, and every hour, you will encounter another friendly Virsamal! short: Chun-Li from Street Fighter 6 joins Desktop Mate! In a Desktop Mate first, click her rapidly to blast windows away with her Spinning Bird Kick, or keep clicking to unleash her Level 3 Super Art, Soten Ranka. Features OD moves, Burnout, Stun, and in-games voice in Japanese and English.
about: Chun-Li from Capcom's fighting game Street Fighter 6 joins Desktop Mate!    A former high-kicking ICPO agent, Chun-Li now runs kung fu classes and has become a well-loved member of the local community, with Shadaloo sundered. This DLC brings her to Desktop Mate under the supervision of CAPCOM Co., Ltd.  The highlight of this DLC is the "Move Action" feature, a Desktop Mate first that lets you blast windows away. Click her rapidly to unleash her special move, the Spinning Bird Kick. Spinning forward with her kicks, she pushes into windows and sends them flying. Windows that are blown away bounce off the edges of the screen before coming to a stop. Keep clicking even more, and the Move Action powers up into her Level 3 Super Art, Soten Ranka, sending windows flying with explosive force.  From time to time, her special move turns into its "OD (Overdrive) version," wrapped in a golden aura. Each OD move consumes the Drive Gauge, and once the gauge is empty, she enters a "Burnout" state, surrounded by a gray aura. Click her in this state and she'll collapse in a "Stun"—a touch unique to Desktop Mate.  Normally, she shows off her signature stance, or hops up happily in a joyful pose. In her standing pose, she trains hard, kicking her legs up high and doing squats with a barbell on her shoulders. When seated, she tidies her appearance and spritzes on some perfume. Since Move Actions only trigger when you click her rapidly, she stays by your side on your desktop without getting in the way of your work.  Her voice lines come straight from Street Fighter 6, in both Japanese and English. When she unleashes her special move, she lets out familiar battle cries such as "Spinning Bird Kick!" With Multi-Character Mode, you can also display her alongside Ryu.     ◯Features   ・A Desktop Mate first: the "Move Action" feature that blasts windows away  ・Unleash her special move "Spinning Bird Kick" and her Level 3 Super Art "Soten Ranka"  ・Street Fighter 6-inspired effects, including OD versions, the Drive Gauge, Burnout, and Stun  ・Signature Chun-Li motions: her familiar stance, training, tidying up and spritzing perfume, and more  ・In-game voice lines from Street Fighter 6 (available in Japanese and English)  ・3D model supervised by CAPCOM Co., Ltd.   ◯How to Use Move Actions   While the character is standing idle, click on the character rapidly and rhythmically. The move changes depending on how many times you click.  ・Click once: Normal poke reaction  ・Click 5+ times: Special move "Spinning Bird Kick"  ・Click 10+ times: Charge motion, then Level 3 Super Art "Soten Ranka"   ・Each time a special move is performed, there is a 50% chance it changes into its OD version. In the OD version, the character is surrounded by a golden aura, and the Drive Gauge appears above the character's head. There is no way to trigger the OD version on purpose, so just keep performing special moves.  ・The direction of the move is determined by where you last clicked. Click to the right of the character's center to attack to the right, or to the left of the center to attack to the left.  ・If there is a pause between clicks, the clicking is treated as finished. If you have clicked fewer than 5 times at that point, no move is performed and the character returns to standing.  ・Place a window in the direction of the move to see the move hit the window.  ・Moves cannot be performed while the character is sitting, being grabbed, appearing, or exiting.     ◯How to Stun   1. name: dEskape
lang: English**
short: 'dEskape' is a base-building game which sits across the bottom of your desktop allowing you to work, browse, or watch something else while you play. It's idle when you like and active when you want.
about: From the team that made Desktopia comes 'dEskape': a new world to build, manage, and defend at the bottom of your desktop!  At its core, 'dEskape' is a base-building game which sits across the bottom of your desktop allowing you to work, browse, or watch something else while you play. It's idle when you like and active when you want.  Like any base-builder, you get to make the big decisions while taking control of your own laser shooting, resource-collecting character whose only objective is repairing their broken ship and getting off the dark and dreary rock onto which they've crashed.         SPECIAL FEATURES        A completely original approach in PC gaming: designed with functionality in mind, 'dEskape' allows you to use your PC for multiple purposes on a single monitor.       Clever UI: with resizeable pop-out windows which can be arranged anywhere on your screen, including a radar, log and build menu.       A playable character which you can level up allowing you to jump into the action whenever you want.       Mystical, weather and lighting effects that are a delight for the eyes.       A fully circular planet: keep walking one way and you'll arrive back home.       A high-power active mode where resources are plentiful but so are the enemies, and a low-power idle mode for when your attention is elsewhere..          THE GAME        From nothing but the ruins of your ship: construct the infrastructure to escape the planet and build a truly massive base.       Construct a range of facilities (factories, research labs, alien technology, mystical crops) and watch as storage creatures and aliens take up residence around your base.       Wander away from the safety of your base to find resources and crashed resource pods.       Research strange creatures and use them to create new and powerful resources.       Construct droids, level them up, give them new skills, and take them out into the dark to collect resources, and destroy the dangerous blood hives that are attracted to your industry.       Research new weapon types, and wield them against the dark creatures which try to steal your light.

name: Meowgic Egg Idle
lang: English, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Spanish - Latin America
short: Raise adorable Meowgic Eggs on a little ranch at the bottom of your desktop. Unlock auto-hatching and let new eggs hatch while you work or browse. Your bigger creatures battle for coins on their own. Drop back in to merge them, upgrade the ranch, and take on the Demon King.
about: In  Meowgic Egg Idle , your desktop becomes a tiny ranch.   Meowgic Eggs fall from the sky—move your mouse and click to hatch them!  Gather enough small eggs of the same kind to merge them into stronger Giant Eggs.  Watch your Giant Eggs head into battle, defeat enemies, earn gold, and upgrade your ranch to make things even more hands-free.    Unlock different feeds and the Bestiary to meet an expanding roster of Meowgic Eggs, each with their own quirky personalities.  Visit the shop whenever you need a boost: Auto-Hatcher, Rapid Spawn, Divine Fusion... plenty of handy features await.  Push all the way to the endgame, or start a New Game+ to keep your farm thriving.  —And of course, it comes with a "Boss Key" to minimize the window in an instant.  Love customizing? You can even replace the character portraits and Bestiary lore with your own images and text to create a truly unique egg ranch.   Perfect for when you just want to relax, idle, click around a bit, and watch your Meowgic Eggs grow stronger.      In the full release, we’ve added an all-new  [Custom Egg / Monster]  feature!            Simply click the  [Customize]  button under  [Settings]  and follow the quick guide to replace the image files—instantly transforming your eggs into any look you desire!                  Come raise your very own, one-of-a-kind companions!

name: Idle Rat: Island Digger
lang: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Portuguese - Brazil
short: A relaxing pixel art idle digging game. A clever little rat uncovers treasures beneath a tropical island while running on top of all applications. Upgrade your stats, sell your finds, and progress at your own pace.
about: Idle Rat: Island Digger   Dig. Discover. Relax. Always on top.   Idle Rat: Island Digger is a cozy idle digging game about small progress, quiet satisfaction, and watching a tiny worker do its thing while you focus on whatever else you’re doing.  A clever little rat has arrived on a peaceful tropical island, and beneath the sand lies a whole world waiting to be uncovered. Dig through layers of sand and stone, discover hidden treasures, sell what you find, and slowly turn effort into steady progress.  The game is designed to be  always on top of all applications . It stays visible above everything else on your desktop, so your rat keeps digging while you work, browse, watch videos, or relax. You can freely move and resize the window to fit your perfect setup. This is not just a feature, it is the core experience.  Play actively or let it run quietly in the background. Your rat never stops working.  Dig at Your Own Pace  Watch your rat dig automatically, layer by layer. There is no rush, no pressure, and no failure. Just steady progress as the underground slowly reveals its secrets.          Discover and Sell  As you dig deeper, you will uncover valuable resources and rare items hidden beneath the island. Everything you dig can be sold to earn coins, which you then use to grow stronger and dig even further.          Deep Upgrade System  Customize your progress with  6 different upgrades , each changing how your rat works underground:          🚀  Speed  Dig faster and reach deeper layers more quickly.  🍀  Luck  Increase your chances of finding rare and valuable items.  😴  Rest Time  Reduce downtime so your rat gets back to digging sooner.  💰  Sell Bonus  Earn more coins from every item you sell.  🎒  Inventory Capacity  Carry more items before needing to sell.  🤖  Auto Sell  Automatically sell items to keep progress flowing smoothly.  Each upgrade pushes you deeper and makes the idle loop more satisfying.  Customize Your Cozy Setup  Idle Rat is not just about numbers. You can personalize your little island by purchasing and equipping different skins.  🐀  Character Skins   Change your rat’s appearance by purchasing and equipping different skins.        ⛺  Tents   Buy and switch between different tent designs to customize your island. 🪑  Chairs   Replace your chair with cozy alternatives to complete your setup.          Buy them, equip them, and create a setup that feels uniquely yours.  Made to Stay With You  The always on top window turns Idle Rat into a companion game. It lives on your screen while you do other things, quietly making progress. Resize it, move it anywhere, and let it blend into your daily routine.  A Calm Pixel Art World  Enjoy a peaceful tropical atmosphere brought to life with charming pixel art and smooth idle animations. Everything is designed to feel relaxing, warm, and unobtrusive.  Idle Rat: Island Digger is about slowing down, enjoying small wins, and letting progress happen naturally.  Sit back, keep it on top, and let your tiny rat dig deeper. 🌊🐀

name: Idle Carousel Demo
lang: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese
short: You just took over an old park, and its carousel is ready to spin again! In this cozy idle game, the animals on your carousel sweep away the clutter as they spin. Beat six bosses, watch the seasons change, and bring the park back to life.
about: Welcome to the Idle Carousel demo! The park's old carousel is ready to spin again, but the grounds are buried in clutter. Earn Gold, upgrade your carousel, and bring animal mounts aboard to clear the way.  In the demo     Three bosses:  the Leaf Storm, the Whirlwind and the Overflowing Bin, each stamped on your Season Ticket.     Your first mounts:  Wolves sweep, Giraffes reach far, Sloths slow clutter down, Elephants guard the rim and Pandas patch the ride.     Desktop mode:  shrink the game into a little round window and leave it spinning while you work.     Demo seasons:  earn Golden Tickets for the Prize Booth and Park Supplies for your first park pieces.     Two achievements:  Opening Day Rehearsal and Desk Job.      The full game adds three more bosses, a grand finale, challenges, and the whole park to restore.

name: Vanguard Galaxy
lang: English
short: A relaxing game about space exploration that can be played full screen or at the bottom of your screen. Trade, fight, mine and salvage your way through a procedurally generated galaxy. Let the game idle while your autopilot handles business and builds your fortune.
about: The Great Gate has opened; adventure and riches await!  Welcome to the Canis Major dwarf galaxy! We hope that your trip through the Great Gate was a safe one; many of the fortune-seekers that embark on this dangerous journey never make it this far. After all, an unauthorized jump of 25,000 light years through a heavily guarded artificial wormhole is bound to cause some issues – both technical and legal. Thankfully, now that you’re here, it’s time to get straight to business.  Key features     Choose your own playstyle    Combat : Fight enemies using a wide range of weaponry.  Mining : Scrape asteroid surfaces or blow them to bits to harvest their core.  Salvage : Discover and salvage derelict ships and wreckage.  Trading : Find the best trade routes. Buy low, sell high.     Play the game full screen or place it on the bottom of your desktop  You can let the autopilot play idle or take a more hands on approach.     Find and collect loot   You'll find powerful gear and rare items that allow you to push further into the sectors.     Buy and upgrade new ships   Choose from a wide variety of ships, ranging from small miners to large destroyers.     Dynamic NPC captains  From rival pirates and traders to helpful miners. Interact, ally, fight or avoid them.     Refine raw ore/salvage and craft your gear  Raw resources can be refined into materials. Use these materials to craft powerful gear to boost your ships and level up your game. Or sell them for a handy profit.     Level up your captain and hire crew  Pick from multiple skill trees and unlock powerful abilities or focus on becoming an industrial powerhouse. Crew with different professions provide passive perks and unique bonuses that enhance your skill trees.     Explore a vast, procedurally generated galaxy   Travel using the gate-network.     Story & dynamic missions   A wide range of different missions that will require you to diversify your ships.    Let the game idle while you work  Play Vanguard Galaxy full screen on a second monitor or place it at the  bottom of your screen.  It stays out of your way when you need to focus on something else (work, play another game, or watch a video). Engage the Autopilot and your ship’s ECHO system will complete most basic tasks on its own, with minimal input required from you.       Explore a destabilizing galaxy  You are let loose in a procedurally generated world where corporate interests clash with the galaxy’s established population. Pledge allegiance to one of the corporations, or stay neutral and forge your own path. The world reacts to your actions and builds its own storyline as you explore new systems and make a name for yourself.          Reach the top  Level up your captain and crew, and equip all of your space ships with top-of-the-line components. The deepest reaches of the galaxy may be savage and unpredictable, but with sufficient preparation you’ll be ready for any challenge it can throw at you.

name: Aetherdrifter
lang: English**
short: A deep sci-fi idle RPG. Mine and salvage dead fleets, refine matter into alloy, fabricate parts, and rebuild your ship from a scout to a world-sized Ark. Fight ship-vs-sector battles, chart a starfield, automate the grind, and keep earning while you're away.
about: The stars went quiet, and no one is coming. So you begin.     A thousand years ago the Severance cut the Weave — the living lattice that let minds and ships cross the dark — and the galaxy fell silent, sector by sector. You are the Core: an ancient ship-mind, finally awake, on a hull that should not still be running. There's no crew left to give the orders. There's just the work, the long quiet, and a signal out past the wreck-fields that knows your name.    AETHERDRIFTER is a deep idle RPG in the Melvor / OSRS lineage — built to reward an hour or a glance. Set a discipline running and watch the numbers climb; come back to salvage hauls, charted stars, and the next thread of a real mystery. It keeps earning while you're away — bit-deterministic, honest offline progress, no fake timers.     Rebuild the Ark.  Eleven interlocking skills feed one another in a single web: gather → refine → fabricate → fight → reclaim. Mine and salvage the dead fleets, refine raw matter into alloy, fabricate components, garden a hydroponics bay, chart a 217-hex starfield, and weave reclaimed Aether into power. Everything you make goes into the one thing that matters: your ship.     The ship is the spine.  Climb the chassis ladder from a Scout Skiff to a world-sized Ark, fitting weapons, plating, reactors and drives into a real mass-and-power budget. Combat is ship-vs-sector — a damage triangle of kinetic / ballistic / aetheric, sustain economies, toggle-able Protocols, and multi-phase bosses — not a personal inventory of swords.     A story told in the margins.  The Adventure Log threads a genuine arc and a recurring cast — traders, wardens, a hollowed courier, a Core like you but colder — through the idle loop. Nothing is lore-noise. It builds to The Long Dawn: a three-way choice at the heart of the dark with no clean answer, and a New Game+ that lets every rebuild be a different morning.     For the collectors.  A browsable Codex, 100 laddered achievements, a four-faction galaxy with its own Senate and relics, a crew you bond with, and a hundred small mended things to find. 100% is reachable — and the game knows it. Original IP, a strict written voice, and cohesive bespoke art — a lived-in universe that reads as one authored thing. Plays full-screen on desktop and one-handed on a phone.    Wake the Core. Rebuild the Ark. Cross the long quiet the stars left behind.       Eleven interlocking skills  — gather → refine → fabricate → fight → reclaim, each with a signature mechanic and a Mastery second axis.     Your ship is your character  — Scout Skiff to Ark, real mass/power budgets, 100+ components, ship-vs-sector combat with a damage triangle and multi-phase bosses.     A real, ambient story  — a genuine mystery and a recurring cast in the Adventure Log, building to the three-way Long Dawn ending + a New Game+ loop.     Honest idle  — bit-deterministic offline progress; rewards a glance or a long session, never fake waiting.     Built for collectors  — a browsable Codex, 180 achievements, factions + a Galactic Senate + relics, crew bonds, 100%-reachable completion.     Desktop and phone  — a dense full-screen layout and a one-handed compact mode from the same save.     Unique sci-fi  — original IP, a strict voice, bespoke art; awe and melancholy and stubborn hope, not generic grimdark.

name: Take Good Care of Your Cassava
lang: English, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil
short: A tiny Brazilian June festival that dances on your desktop. Mandioca dances on her own while you work: every step earns Cheer, Cheer brings guests.
about: A June festival that lives on your desktop  Take Good Care of Your Cassava is a cozy idle game inspired by Brazil’s festas juninas, the colorful June festivals full of bonfires, bunting, square dancing and corn treats. The party floats on top of your desktop, right next to your spreadsheets and browser tabs, and keeps growing while you work, study or play.    Dance, rest, repeat  Mandioca dances all by herself, and every step earns Cheer. When she gets tired she takes a break, then comes back with everything she’s got. Upgrade her Wiggle, Stamina, Refreshment and Rhythm and watch the party earn more and more.    From backyard party to the World’s Biggest São João  All the Cheer you gather slowly turns into fame, and fame brings guests. Every new guest adds something to the scenery: a corn stalk, a hen and her chicks, a sleepy cat, a goat, a little chapel, a Ferris wheel. Your backyard arraiá becomes a neighborhood fair, a town festival and, one day, the biggest São João in the world.    Plenty to do (or not)     Lucky Rings:  a ring toss minigame with multipliers and exclusive prizes. The better the prize, the steadier your hand needs to be.     The crew:  catch characters at the fishing pond, like Corn, Carrot, Yam, Hot Dog and the ultra-rare Spark. Each one has a job that changes the party.     Outings and the bonfire:  send the crew to fetch firewood and feed the bonfire until it becomes legendary.     Shop:  hats, fabrics, dance floors, decorations and booths, with an instant preview on the party.     Love letters, requests and party crashers:  little surprises that keep the festival lively.     History:  a diary and a chart of everything your party unlocked, and when.

Three Phases of the day     Dawn, dusk, and night — each with its own light, mist, and drifting fireflies            Make the island yours    Level up to unlock new looks for Dusky and his island, light phases, the palette, the music, a few extra animations, and maybe even some new companions.. name: AFK Companion

name: The Fisherman's Forever Faith
lang: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain
short: Meet The Old Fisherman, your chill desktop companion! Watch him cast his line and reel in amazing catches - from tiny minnows to legendary fish - while you work, study, or relax. Features lofi music, digital diary, fish collecting, it's a tiny game that lives anywhere on your desktop.
about: Meet your chill desktop buddy! This laid-back fisherman hangs out on your screen, casting lines and catching fish while you work or study. Features lofi tunes, a digital diary, fish collecting, and relaxing idle gameplay right on your desktop.     Your Desktop's Chillest Fishing Buddy!   Turn your workspace into a cozy  place with The Fisherman's Forever Faith. It's not just another idle game—it's like having a calm fishing friend who's always there, sharing little thoughts about life and the perfect catch while you get stuff done.   🎣 Your Fishing Buddy in Action           If you're tired of fast-paced games, you're going to love the fisherman's rhythm. Some days luck is on his side and he'll pull in dozens of fish back-to-back. Other days? Well, that's fishing for you—sometimes the fish just aren't biting. But that's part of the charm. Pure chill vibes with zero pressure.     📓 Digital Diary That Actually Works            Easy Diary Features : Write whatever you want with nice formatting, organize with colored tags, and actually find your old entries with search.   Daily Wisdom : Your fishing buddy drops little life observations and fishing thoughts—nothing preachy, just nice stuff to read.   Your Space : Jot down ideas, goals, or random thoughts in a diary that feels good to use.     💬 Stories & Wisdom from the Water            Daily Wisdom : Your fishing buddy drops little life observations and fishing thoughts—nothing preachy, just nice stuff to read.   The Old Fisherman's Stories : Between catches, he loves sharing memories from his years by the water. Tales of the biggest fish that got away, storms he's weathered, quiet mornings when the lake was like glass, and life lessons learned from a lifetime of fishing. Each story feels like sitting by a campfire with your grandfather, hearing about the good old days. Sometimes funny, sometimes touching, always genuine.     🌅 Always Changing Scenery           The view keeps things interesting:     Day/Night : The sky follows your computer's real time—so when it's night for you, it's night for the fisherman too     Weather Changes : Light drizzle, heavy rain, thick fog, or bright sunshine—the weather keeps things interesting     Different Seasons : Five different lakeside views that switch up     Moving Water : Gentle waves and reflections that look alive       🎣 Fishing That Makes Sense            7 Different Hooks : Each one works differently—some are faster, some catch rarer fish. But here's the thing—hooks can break or get lost! When that happens, the Old Fisherman takes it as a perfect excuse for a well-deserved nap while you replace his gear. It's a nice little reminder that even in a chill game, sometimes you need to step in and help out your buddy.   Fish Collection : Keep track of everything you've caught    Daily Luck : Some days the fish bite more than others    Gear Stuff : Buy new hooks, sell old ones, figure out what works best     🎵 Perfect Background Vibes           Handpicked lofi music that help you focus without being distracting with gentle water and rain sounds when you want them     🎣 Plenty Of Stories    🌟 What You Get      Chill Fishing Friend  who's always hanging out with good vibes     Works on Your Desktop  - float it anywhere on your monitor     Actually Useful Diary  with tags and search that works     47 Fish to Collect  from common to super rare     Scenery That Changes  with day, night, and weather     Cozy Pixel Art  that looks great without being flashy     Make It Yours  - adjust whatever you want     Multiple Languages  so everyone can enjoy it       Perfect For:  Students who want something calm while studying • People working from home who need good background vibes • Anyone who likes collecting stuff • Fans of pixel art and nature • People who want to chill out without getting bored    Your fishing buddy is ready to hang out. Ready to cast your first line?

name: Idle Agency
lang: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil, Korean
short: A single-player idle looter. Arrange heroes on a 4×4 grid; they auto-battle and loot offline. Train up and push on. Beaten bosses join you; Guardian Spirits fight too. Build the Fortress, research, sell or buy at the Market. The full game adds the Trial Tower and Steam Community Market.
about: Idle Agency is a single-player game about collecting heroes, building teams and growing at your own pace. Recruit companions and place them on a 4×4 board, then watch them fight automatically. When a battle gets tough, change a position, add a support hero or swap some equipment—and try again.             The battle can become its own mini window. Drag it to the side of your desktop or onto another screen and it keeps going; lower the opacity if you like, and hover over it to see it clearly for a moment.             Your heroes battle on their own, and the gear they win goes straight into storage. Even with the game closed, the drops keep coming and your agency keeps producing resources. When you return, watch the resource and loot reveal, where epic and legendary drops get their own effects. Then check the Offline Debrief, open chests at the Blacksmith, and give your heroes the best pieces.                Eligible gear can be traded with other players on the Steam Community Market. Not all gear is tradable.             Explore each hero's skills, class and growth path. Balance damage, frontline protection and healing. Levels, ranks, mastery and signature equipment give your companions room to grow. Some heroes also have animated portraits.             Position heroes and guardian spirits on a 4×4 board, balancing frontline protection, damage and support. Class synergies and morale shape the fight. Check the battle report, see what worked and adjust your lineup.             Hatch spirit eggs, raise guardian spirits and place them on the 4×4 board. Positioning and hero class affinities shape their bonuses and combat echoes. Levels, spirit grades, awakening and glyphs make these companions part of your build.             Build resource facilities, research Academy upgrades, and arrange commissions and farming. Agency production accumulates while you are offline. Come back, collect your resources and prepare for another challenge. Item cards explain what materials do and where to find them.             Advance through the campaign and challenge bosses. Your first victory over a recruitable boss brings that hero into the agency.             The full game includes the Trial Tower: choose blessings and routes, climb higher and collect trial legendary equipment and seals. Try a different team and see how far your next run can go.

name: Fishbobble
lang: English, Portuguese - Brazil
short: A cozy pond that sits in the corner of your screen: your fisher fishes on their own while you work or play. Clear each pond's stages, upgrade your gear, adopt a pet and build a collection of one-of-a-kind fish.
about: Fishbobble  is an idle fishing game that lives on your desktop. The pond floats in a corner of your screen without getting in the way, and your fisher casts, waits and fights the fish on their own. Whenever you like, open the tackle box and decide what to do with your catch.           Every fish is one of a kind.  Size, weight, stars, rarity and rare variants (albino, golden, aurora, giant and shadow) change from catch to catch. The bestiary records every species you find.   Ponds with stages and bosses.  From the Backyard to the Moon Well, each pond has ten stages with different goals and a boss fish at the end. Secret ponds open for 24 hours when you make offerings at the altars.           Plenty to do with your fish.  Sell them at the village market, grind them into feed or clean them for materials; fill village orders to raise your reputation; cook dishes for short bonuses, mount trophies and show fish in your aquarium; breed pairs for fry; and enter the weekly tournaments.   Gear and talents.  Rod, reel, line, hook, bait and handle make up your set. Upgrade everything to +10 with gems found while fishing, repair your rod at the bench and pick talents that fit your style.   A friend on the bank.  At level 10 a hungry pup shows up. Take care of it, choose who it is and give it a name: cat, dog or otter, each with a small helping hand.   Made to stay open.  It saves power while you are not interacting, only notifies what matters and never starts with your computer on its own.           Early Access.  The full fishing and progression game is available now. Trading fish and cosmetics through the Steam Inventory will open in stages after launch, with anti-bot limits from day one.
