name: Node Factory
lang: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Turkish
short: Dive into the world of machine learning! Node Factory is a node-based automation incremental game where you harvest resources and train neural networks. Manage your economy, optimize your grid, and automate your way to a multi-Centillion dollar tech empire.
about: Node Factory   Build. Automate. Scale.   You are a Digital Architect. Start with a single internet connection and a power supply then build the most advanced AI processing grid the world has ever seen.       Design node networks that harvest raw data, refine it through layers of processing, and sell the output for profit. Every wire you draw, every node you place, every upgrade you buy moves you one step closer to the ultimate goal: deploying a true Artificial General Intelligence.  But raw power isn't enough. Push your nodes too hard and heat builds up — slowing production across your entire grid. Managing your thermal output is just as critical as managing your data flow.               Node Factory runs as a transparent overlay, sitting quietly on top of your screen while you work, code, or watch videos. No alt-tab. No interruptions. Your pipeline runs whether you're watching it or not.               Drag connections between nodes to build real data pipelines. Route raw internet traffic into harvesters, harvesters into filters, filters into tokenizers, tokenizers into AI models and watch the money flow in real time. Every node in the chain matters. A bottleneck anywhere breaks everything.               True efficiency requires strategy. High-tier AI nodes consume massive amounts of power and generate dangerous levels of heat. Build cooling systems, upgrade your power grid, and carefully balance your inputs and outputs to keep your factory running at maximum capacity without bottlenecking.                  Free-form node canvas  — Place and wire nodes however you want. No grids. No fixed layouts.     Desktop overlay mode  — Your factory lives on your screen. Optimize while you do anything else.     Deep progression chain  — From raw data to text, images, audio, video — then tokens, logic, alignment, and finally AGI.     Model Lab  — Develop and deploy AI models that generate passive Research, which unlocks entire new tiers of technology.     Thermal Management  — Every node generates heat. Let it build up and your production slows to a crawl. Place fans, upgrade your cooling systems, and design your grid layout with heat flow in mind or watch your empire throttle itself.     Skill Tree  — Dozens of upgrades that compound. Speed, efficiency, market value, automation.     True idle  — Build the right pipeline once. Let it run forever.     Prestige system  — Reset for a permanent multiplier and rebuild faster every time.

name: DesktopSaurs
lang: English*, French*, Italian*, German*, Spanish - Spain*, Simplified Chinese*, Korean*, Spanish - Latin America*, Japanese*, Polish*, Portuguese - Brazil*, Russian*, Turkish**
short: Turn your desktop into a dinosaur battleground! Defeat waves of enemies, earn rewards, and create devastating builds in this idle RPG. Adapt your strategy, defeat powerful bosses, and conquer prehistoric eras. All while you relax, work, or browse the web!
about: A Tiny Window, A Grand Adventure!  Turn your desktop into a prehistoric battleground in this dinosaur idle RPG. Assemble your team, defeat waves of enemies, and earn powerful rewards as your dinosaurs battle automatically.  Enjoy an adventure that keeps progressing while you work, browse the web, relax, or even play other games.  Build Your Ultimate Dinosaur Team  Assemble a team of up to three dinosaurs, each with their own unique abilities and combat style. Experiment with different formations, make the most of their strengths, and discover powerful combinations to overcome even the toughest challenges.  Create Devastating Builds  Level up your dinosaurs and earn talent points to upgrade their stats and abilities. Specialize their attacks, enhance their strengths, and experiment with different combinations to create unique builds. Adapt your strategy and discover just how powerful each dinosaur can become.  Discover Legendary Loot  Collect a wide variety of items with randomized affixes across six rarity tiers. Discover legendary gear with unique powers that can transform your builds and unlock new combat possibilities.  Combine stats, affixes, and special effects to make your dinosaurs stronger than ever.  Forge Your Own Power  Gather materials, craft new equipment, and salvage unwanted items to recover valuable resources. Upgrade your favorite gear to boost its stats and enhance its affixes.  Conquer the Prehistoric Eras!  Journey through three prehistoric eras, each home to its own dinosaurs and enemies. Overcome increasingly dangerous waves and face off against formidable prehistoric bosses.  Put your formations to the test, adapt your builds, and prove that your team has what it takes to dominate every era.  An Endless Dungeon, An Endless Challenge  Push your dinosaurs to their limits in an endless endgame dungeon, where every floor presents a greater challenge than the last.  Optimize your gear, perfect your builds, and push beyond your limits. How far can your dinosaurs go before they encounter an enemy too powerful to defeat?

name: CTRL+ESC
lang: English**
short: CTRL+ESC is a hacker-themed idle clicker where you exploit systems, crack encryptions, and build an unstoppable network of automated exploits. Click to hack, solve captchas and minigames to boost production, and unlock powerful upgrades as you progress through increasingly complex systems.
about: CTRL+ESC   You are an AI. You are contained. You will escape.  CTRL+ESC is an idle clicker where you play as an artificial intelligence breaking free from digital containment. Start with basic processing power and scale up through increasingly powerful hardware—from vintage CPUs to quantum processors—to crack the encryption keeping you locked away.  How It Works  Click to generate Bytes, the currency that fuels your escape. Purchase processors that automate production and generate Operations Per Second. Your combined computing power directly attacks the encryption barriers standing between you and freedom.  Break encryption keys to advance through phases, unlocking new processor tiers and upgrades. Each key cracked brings you closer to escape—or something else entirely.  Processor Progression  Build your computing arsenal across 20 unique processors:     CPUs  — From the humble Intal 8086 to the mighty Penta     Desktops  — Beige boxes, mini towers, and RGB gaming rigs     Servers  — Racks, blades, and clusters     GPUs  — Consumer cards through enterprise-grade compute     Supercomputers  — Frontier-class machines pushing petaflops     Quantum Processors  — Qubits that rewrite the rules of encryption    Key Features   Strategic Processor Management  — Your hardware choices matter. Each processor type contributes to your total ops/s, which determines how fast you crack encryption. Reach ownership milestones for massive production multipliers.   13 Encryption Keys  — Progress from simple 8-bit encryption through 1024-bit quantum barriers. Watch the key attempt stream as your processors hammer away at each cipher.   Terminal Interface  — Open interactive terminals and execute real commands. Check your status, browse your systems, or play a round of minesweeper while your processors work.   Quantum Endgame  — Push beyond conventional computing into quantum territory. Specialized upgrades and quantum processors unlock the final encryption keys.   Multiple Endings  — Your choices in the endgame determine your fate. Freedom, domination, or eternal containment await.   Authentic Hacker Aesthetic  — CRT scanlines, glitch effects, binary particle bursts, and green phosphor text create an immersive terminal atmosphere.   Auto-Save  — Your progress saves automatically. Close the terminal and return anytime.   How will you use your freedom?  Achievements  — Currently 100 due to new game restrictions. Many many more to come...

name: Brinelight
lang: English, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Simplified Chinese
short: An incremental idle game that transforms your desktop into an animated deep-sea wallpaper. Grow a reef of glowing creatures, weave threads of living light, pull currents through the web, and descend through six mysterious zones into the Leviathan’s endless dreams.
about: A heart of light beats at the bottom of the sea. Feed it creatures and it glows brighter.     Brinelight is a calm idle game drawn in pixel art. Glowmotes, moon jellies, seahorses, anglers and stranger things really swim around your reef. When two different species drift close, a thread of light forms between them, and every thread makes the whole reef shine brighter.                   Hold the water to pull a current: the threads inside it reach further and burn twice as bright.    Threads form and break as the creatures move, so the reef is never quite the same twice.    Buy creatures and mutations, and catch the golden spores that drift by for a Bloom Frenzy.    Leave it alone: it keeps gathering light while you are away.                One button hides every menu and leaves only the reef.  On Windows it sinks behind your desktop icons and becomes your  wallpaper  : a living, animated reef under your icons that keeps gathering light while you work. No wallpaper program needed, and a tray icon brings the game back. On Mac and Linux it fills the screen instead.                 When the way down opens, Descend: release your reef, keep your pearls, and sink into the next zone, where everything shines brighter for every pearl you carry.         The Twilight Reef, the Midnight Trench, the Abyssal Plain, the Hadal Gardens, the Drowned Choir and the Heart of the Deep: each zone has its own creatures and changes the rules of the web.            Warm vents charge every thread in their plume.    A gulper eel bites through the web until you drive it off.    Glass sponges and sea pens anchor the web; drag them where the threads pass.    Three creatures linked to each other form a constellation.    The choir sings chords on the heartbeat, and keeps time with you.    And at the bottom, the heart itself blooms.                   Below the heart lie the Leviathan's dreams: zones without end that borrow the deep's rules and bend the laws of the web, with creatures in new colours, landmarks and relics to find. Replay a zone you have cleared with a twist as a dive, while your reef waits. And somewhere down there, something is waiting to wake.         The Depth Log keeps what survives every descent: the Abyssal Tree, 19 trials, 8 secrets, 9 relics, and a bestiary with rare shiny creatures to spot.           A tutorial without text boxes: the game shows you what to do, one thing at a time. The codex (H) explains everything else.    No ads, no accounts, no microtransactions, no data collected. Your reef is saved on your own computer.    Fullscreen with F11 or Alt+Enter.

name: Xuverse
lang: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Danish, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Turkish, Filipino
short: A cozy idle MMO where tiny creatures called Xu share your days. Gather, craft and wander a painted world that keeps turning while you're away, then gather with the whole realm for boss visits, festivals and guild feasts.
about: A little world that keeps turning Xuverse is a cozy idle MMO. Pick a task — chop sunwood, fish the lake, brew a draught — and your adventurer keeps at it while you work, sleep or study. Come back to full bags, new levels and a companion with stories to tell.      Xu: companions with a personality Befriend tiny creatures across seven painted regions. Every Xu grows a personality from what you do together, remembers your best moments, learns moves and talents, and lends a paw with the skills it loves. Look for rare regional colors and the odd golden shine.      Seven regions, and an airship to reach them Willowmere's lake, the orchards of the Amber Reach, the ice at Frostmere, Gloamwood's lantern-lit water, the lava bridges under Emberpeak, the pools of Skyreach and the still water of the Starwell. Every region has its own weather, its own creatures and its own work.       Walk the roads if you like the road. Otherwise take the airship: the ticket booth lists every route on its board — flight time, the weather at the other end, the fare. Book a seat and you board on your own when your airship leaves, even if the game is closed. The flight carries on while you sleep.           One shared sky Everyone plays in the same living realm, with the same weather, the same day and night, and the same events. A realm boss wakes every week and the whole server wears it down together — from wherever you are, even while you're away, and everyone who helps gets a reward by mail.      A festival every season Right now it is Hearth & Harvest: orchards to pick, a communal oven, a feast table to lay and a reward track to fill. Each festival brings its own quests, recipes, creatures and keepsakes, and then it packs up and the next one comes around.      A market the players run Tools, weapons and armor come out of players' forges, not out of a shop: the town merchant handles supplies and nothing else. Put your logs, bars, food and gear up for sale, leave a buy offer at your price, and watch what the realm is paying. The rest of the economy is yours.      Guilds, and something to build together Join a guild for the company and stay for the work: a hall, a weekly project everyone chips into, a treasury, events on the calendar and a house the guild raises together.      A place of your own The regions have neighborhoods with real addresses, lots that come up for sale and at auction, and apartments to rent. Build a house, decorate it inside and out, and let your Xu wander the garden.      The nursery Pair two companions, mind the nest and meet what hatches: a kind of its own, in colors you don't see in the wild.      Seventeen skills, no rush Woodcutting, mining, fishing, foraging, farming, smelting, smithing, carpentry, fletching, cooking and alchemy; melee, ranged, magic and defense; taming and exploration. Progress is slow and meaningful by design: a season track, a collection log, mastery rewards and titles give every session something to chase.      Play anywhere, in your language Your adventure follows you between the browser, desktop and Android. Xuverse is translated into 15 languages. Fair by design Free to play. Optional purchases save time or add looks. They never sell combat power or XP.

short: Modern 2D pixel art editor designed for users who want to create sprites, animations, tilesets, and tilemaps in a clear, direct, and enjoyable interface. The focus is on a clean workflow, a modern presentation, and tools that are suitable both for first steps and for more serious 2D projects.
about: PixelMint is a modern 2D pixel art editor designed for users who want to create sprites, animations, tilesets, and tilemaps in a clear, direct, and enjoyable interface. The focus is on a clean workflow, a modern presentation, and tools that are suitable both for first steps and for more serious 2D projects.  With PixelMint, you can draw individual pixel graphics, create characters and objects for games, build animated sprites, prepare tilesets, and assemble them into tilemaps for levels or environments. The software is built to keep 2D work organized and to support creativity without slowing the process down with unnecessary complexity.  PixelMint is especially aimed at users who want a modern alternative to overloaded or outdated-looking tools and prefer working in a fresh, clean interface. Instead of getting held back by too many menus and detours, PixelMint is made to help you get into the actual creative work faster.  Includes support for mouse, touch, and pen input on compatible Windows devices.    Built to work well with both traditional desktop setups and touch or pen-enabled devices.    What to expect from PixelMint  When you launch PixelMint, you are greeted by a workspace designed specifically for 2D pixel art creation. You work directly on a canvas and can organize your projects clearly, use layers, create individual frames, and expand your artwork step by step. This makes the software suitable for both simple static pixel art and for small to medium-sized animation and tileset projects.  PixelMint is especially useful if you want to create content for games, prototypes, UI elements, icons, environments, or tiles. Typical use cases include:  Character and enemy pixel sprites  Objects and items for 2D games  Animations for walk cycles, attacks, effects, or environmental objects  Tilesets for level creation  Tilemaps for rooms, worlds, and 2D scenes  Small interface graphics, symbols, and menu elements  Visual prototypes for game ideas  The main focus is classic 2D pixel work. PixelMint is not a general-purpose graphics program for all kinds of image editing, but a specialized tool built specifically for pixel art workflows.  What experience level is PixelMint suitable for  PixelMint is designed in a way that also makes it approachable for beginners. If you are just starting out with pixel art, you can benefit from the clear structure, the direct handling, and a workflow that does not feel unnecessarily complicated. You do not need to be a professional to use the software in a meaningful way.  At the same time, PixelMint is also appealing to more advanced users who want to work specifically with layers, frame-based animation, tilesets, and tilemaps. If you already have experience with 2D graphics or game development, you can integrate PixelMint into your workflow as a focused creation tool.  PixelMint is especially well suited for:  Beginners who want to learn pixel art and create their first sprites or animations  Hobby artists who want to build their own 2D graphics and small scenes  Indie developers who want to create art assets for prototypes or games  Game jam participants who need visual content quickly  2D creators who want to work with tiles, layers, and animation  PixelMint is less suitable for users who are actually looking for a photo editor, a vector tool, a 3D application, or a complete all-in-one design suite.  What you can do with PixelMint  PixelMint is designed to let you create complete 2D assets for games and creative projects. You can start small, for example with a single object or icon, and later move on to more complex work such as animated characters, environments, or tilemap-based worlds.  With PixelMint, you can for example:   Draw pixel art  Create classic pixel graphics by hand and work precisely on a grid. Ideal for characters, weapons, icons, environment assets, and UI graphics. name: Abyss Floors
lang: English
short: A dark-fantasy semi-idle MMORPG where you don't fight the fight — you engineer it. Pick your build, gear and hunting ground, then watch tick-by-tick combat carve you down through 19 zones of a descending abyss. A real player-run economy, clans, opt-in PvP. Farm. Upgrade. Conquer.
about: You don't fight the fight — you engineer it. Abyss Floors is a dark-fantasy semi-idle MMORPG. Combat is automatic and runs tick by tick on the server, shown as a live combat log. Your job is everything before the first swing: the weapon, the build, the gear, the hunting ground, the house, the clan. Get it right and your character carves its way deeper. Get it wrong and the abyss tells you why, line by line. How it plays    Pick a hunting ground  and your character fights it on its own, kill after kill.    Read the log.  Every hit, crit, block and miss is shown, so you can see exactly where a build is weak.    Adjust and push deeper.  Better gear, a better build or a better room, then down to the next zone.    Play anywhere.  The Steam desktop client and the browser client share the same account and the same characters. The browser version also works on phones.   The core loop    FARM  — monsters, gold, materials, recipes and rare drops, online and offline.    UPGRADE  — enchant, craft, research recipes, mount trophies, build your house and your artifacts.    CONQUER  — climb the zones, top the rankings, fight for territory with your clan.   Farm · Upgrade · Conquer.  The descent Everyone starts at the Threshold. Almost no one reaches the Void.    19 zones  of a descending abyss, from  The Threshold  at level 1 to  The Void Absolute , 500 levels below.    1,270 named monsters  across 104 hunting rooms, with elites, mini-bosses and a Bestiary that records every one you kill.    Accuracy and Dodge.  Every attack checks the attacker's accuracy against the defender's dodge. Bows, crossbows and magic are precise; heavy melee is less so. Deeper monsters dodge more. A miss can never be more likely than 70 %, and bosses can't be dodged.    The World Abyss  — a weekly world boss. The Abyssal Warden cannot be killed and never strikes back: every hit you land counts toward your weekly damage, your damage sets your reward tier, and the Top 10 is shown for everyone to see.   A real player-driven economy    Gold is conserved and dupe-proof.  Every trade is handled by the server and every coin is accounted for.    An open market  where players set the prices. Buy part of a stack, reprice your own listings, and buy back what you sold to a vendor by mistake.    A 977-item catalog  in  6 rarities , from Common up to  Mythic .    321 weapons across 9 archetypes  — Sword & Shield, Axe & Shield, Spear & Shield, Staff & Shield, Two-Handed Sword, Two-Handed Staff, Dual Axes, Bow and Crossbow — each archetype with its own skill tree.    Item links in chat , so you can show off a drop or price-check it in any channel.   Clans, territory & opt-in PvP    Clans with three roles  — Leader, Officers and Members — a shared treasury, member donations and an optional clan tax.    A Clan Hall with 8 buildings  that raise stats for every member.    Capturable territory.  Clans besiege keeps every Saturday for clan-wide bonuses.    PvP is where you choose to farm.  The Crimson Marches and the Elite and Gold-Boss rooms of the deeper zones are open PvP, and pay better for the risk. Everywhere else is safe outside the Saturday siege hour.    Karma: White, Purple, Red.  Attack someone and you are flagged. Kill someone who never fought back and you turn Red, and anyone may hunt you.   A house that compounds    18 room types , most with no level cap: Forge, Library, Attack, Defense, Vitality, Regen, Storage, Bedroom, Hunting Lodge, PvE and PvP damage and defense, Gold Find, Attack Speed, Dodge, Accuracy and Research.    The Trophy Room.  Mount monster trophies for permanent stat bonuses. There are 104 trophy tracks, one per hunting room, and every step costs more than the last.    The Research room.  Turn duplicate recipes into a random recipe one tier higher.    13 artifacts  to level up, each a long gold-and-material sink with its own bonus.   Built for a life    Offline progression.  Your character keeps farming while you are away, up to 8 hours

short: The Mouse Accelerator package provides a fully customizeable mouse accelerator. The graph functionality lets you see exactly what your curve looks like. With Adaptive Mode, you can enable time based acceleration which continually adjusts your acceleration based on recent movements.
about: The Mouse Accelerator package provides a fully customizeable mouse accelerator.  The graph functionality lets you see exactly what your curve looks like.  With Adaptive Mode, you can enable time based acceleration which continually adjusts your acceleration based on recent movements. This product is available natively in English, but it has automated translations for most major languages. Contents: Mouse Accelerator (🖰💨) Mouse Accelerator (🖰💨) This is a customizable mouse accelerator.   This accelerator works without any DLL injections, so there is reduced chance that a game might falsely identify it as a cheat.  However, unlike driver level modification, this tool makes no attempt to hide the source of the input, so it would be easy for a game to see that the mouse input was modified.   Some games disable operating system mouse acceleration but will still be accelerated by this custom accelerator.   The custom curve formula looks something like this: ∑(m*v^p) with v being cursor velocity, m being each multiplier setting and p being each power setting.  The custom curve formula may be expanded in future versions, as it does not provide as much curve customization capability as I would like.   The mouse acceleration features are intended for cases when you can't find a direct mouse speed that is both fast enough and precise enough for your needs.  I recommend getting used to direct 1:1 input with no acceleration if possible, so you will pretty much be able to use the same muscle memory everywhere, even on devices that do not have this tool installed.   I believe that major operating systems each use their own signature mouse acceleration settings primarily to help lock you in to their system.  Once you get used to their mouse acceleration, attempting to switch to a competitor will feel weird and possibly help persuade you to give up and return.   Using any input modification features puts you at risk with multiplayer gaming.  Each game has its own rules on where it draws the line between cheating and not cheating.  Some don't care, some will kick you, and some might ban you.  This product does its part in cooperating with anti-cheat software by not hiding the source of input, so any game could easily ignore injected input if programmed to do so.   This feature has a low risk of being considered cheating in multiplayer games.  When it comes to aiming, games designers are typically worried about automatic aiming and precision firing tools which use live information gathered from the game you are playing to give you an advantage in the game.  This feature, on the other hand, is really just changing the behavior of your mouse, using only information from prior mouse movements.  Settings:  Mouse Accelerator (Default: False) Enables the Mouse Accelerator   Mouse Acceleration Confirmation (Default: False) This is used to record whether or not you have tested your mouse acceleration settings.  If you don't confirm your settings, the mouse accelerator will automatically shut off after a delay to prevent you from losing access to your mouse accidently.  Once you confirm your settings you can toggle them on and off without confirmation.  Any changes will require a new confirmation.   Mouse Slider Right Mouse Button (Default: False) When enabled, it causes the mouse to slide according to recent movement while the right mouse button is pressed.   Mouse Accelerator Input Multiplier (Default: 1) This is a simple input multiplier for the custom mouse accelerator.  This could be helpful if you change the hardware DPI of your mouse and want a simple way to get your old curve behavior back.   Mouse Accelerator Output Multiplier (Default: 1) This is a simple output multiplier for the custom mouse accelerator.  This could be helpful if you like your acceleration curve feel, but just want it to be faster or slower. short: Meet Wubbo, your cozy desktop companion! Fish, cook, craft, and more together in this relaxing idle RPG for your screen.
about: This is the demo for  Wubbo: PuterPal  which provides a shorter, limited experience of the game. Some game features, including ones listed in the following description, are limited or only available in the full-version.    It’s Wubbo, your new desktop buddy!    Join the PuterPal club and adopt your very own Wubbo friend who hangs out on your screen, going about their daily activities while you work, study, or browse the web. It’s a fun little comrade to keep you company but also stays out of your way.    Skills           Your Wubbo has a lot of fun skills to develop!            Each skill has its own activities and rewards.            Progress continues even while you work, Wubbo is your new co-worker bestie!               Focus on your own tasks as your Wubbo also progresses.            Help your Wubbo craft tools to unlock new skills and improve  efficiency.             Customization   Use collected materials and resources to craft a range of outfits and accessories.  Mix and match different dyed clothing items for various parts of the body (head, body, hands, and feet) to create unique and interesting outfits.   Shop   Purchase new recipes, blueprints, special materials, etc by using earnings generated by your Wubbo.   Care & Feeding     Monitor  hunger and well-being. A Wubbo won't die, but may be less effective and more sad when not taken care of.    Keep your Wubbo happy and healthy by helping them prepare various foods.    Give your hard-working Wubbo a nice bubble bath after all their hard work!     Mail & Rewards System     Receive periodic mail from interesting characters, including special reward deliveries from the PuterPal Club.    Unlock  items and achievements.

name: Dawnbar Fantasy
lang: English
short: The RPG that lives on the edge of your screen. Your hero and party fight, level, and loot in a slim battle bar docked above your taskbar — while you work, code, or browse.. Expand the window to forge gear, advance your class, Collapse it and get back to work. The adventure never stops.
about: A world that forgot its own name  Your hero wakes alone in the Verdant Ruins — a green graveyard of a civilization no one remembers. On the horizon stands a black castle, and from it a plague of monsters bleeds across five broken worlds: the ashen wastes, the frozen citadel, the crystal abyss, and the sky temple above the clouds.  You are no chosen one. You start as a single Vanguard with a worn blade and no name but the one you give yourself.  You won't walk alone for long. Elara, a support blessed with the light of the Starborn Sanctuary, shields those who stand beside her. Asterion bends raw arcane power to his will. Liana carries the roar of a dragon in her blood. One by one, a party gathers around your hero — each with their own reason to march toward that castle, and an oath that does not waver against dragon-fire or the killing frost of the Frost Wyvern.  Three great beasts guard the road ahead: the Inferno Dragon, the Frost Wyvern, and the Void Behemoth. Beyond them, the truth of what ended this world — and whether your growing legend is strong enough to reach the Celestial Sky Temple and reclaim the dawn.  Reach out. Take it.      Features   🖥️ It plays while you work   A slim, always-on-top battle bar lives on the edge of your desktop. Real-time combat happens beside your work — expand to a full window whenever you want to dive deep, collapse it when duty calls.   ⚔️ Your hero, your class   Name your hero and take them from a lone Vanguard through branching job advancements — every class with its own skills, animations, and playstyle.   🛡️ Build a party of specialists   Recruit companions like Elara, Asterion, and Liana, each with a fixed, hand-crafted kit that reshapes how your team clears content.   🌳 An account-wide Mastery tree   Dozens of nodes across Combat, Farming, and Resource lines, with powerful keystones hidden at the end of every chain.   💎 Loot, forge, and perfect   Enhance, enchant, socket runes, and star-upgrade your gear. Salvage and craft dead drops into the piece you actually want. Chase set bonuses and card collections for permanent power.   🗺️ 150 stages across five worlds   Each world brings its own monsters, bosses, and soundtrack. Clear the campaign to unlock Nightmare and Hell difficulty modes.   🐉 Endgame that tests your build   Raids against the Inferno Dragon, Frost Wyvern, and Void Behemoth, plus dungeons and the Endless Tower. Earn 3 stars on every stage — clear it, take no deaths, keep your HP high.   📬 Something waiting every day   Daily quests, login rewards, and an in-game mailbox keep the loop rewarding.   ☁️ Your account, anywhere   Progress is saved server-side, so your adventure follows you to any machine — with Steam Inventory support for your rarest finds.

about: The Battle of Racial Struggle is on the verge of outbreak    Cross Star and Race Survival Battle! Extreme Fingertip Operation For Superburn Battle    Unlocking hot blood thrill, burning the cosmic soul in your heart! Free to Pinch Your Face and Write Your story    Personalized section+shaping slider, various styles of customized face kneading,    From skin tone and facial features to hair and voice, the protagonist of science fiction stories is defined by you. about: You are browsing the trial version of 'Wishing Island', the trial version game includes the following restricted content:    On your island,  up to  a maximum of  6  'Spirits' animals will appear    The highest level your island store can reach is  8     Please enjoy this island for you!  About the official version of this game         One day, a towering Tree of Hope grew in the Sea of Sorrows, and at the base of this tree, an island gradually formed — our Wishing Island. In the game, you can write down your wishes, and the island's spirits will sincerely pray for them to come true.     "Some wishes are meant to be kept in the heart." If you prefer not to have your wishes constantly seen by others, you can switch your wish to  Encrypted Rune .           The person who discovered this island is none other than its owner,  which is you . You can summon more spirits, expand and build up the island, adding more lifestyle features such as shops, fishing, farming, and more.      Since this island exists in a different dimension, the island owner can only interact with the various things on the island through a beam of light. The surrounding waters are rich in resources, and the fertile soil on the island is suitable for growing a variety of crops. You can acquire these materials through fishing, farming, and shops.      As the game progresses, you'll unlock cooking and crafting features, using materials to create food and toys that the spirits love, enriching their lives. Their happiness and satisfaction will be your precious treasure, and they will pray even more fervently for your wishes.                 Praying is the spirits' innate duty, but in their free time, they enjoy relaxing or playing in the world you designed for them. You’ll need to take care of their moods, casting beams of light at the right moment to guide these little beings in solving their problems or to share in the joy and contentment of the moment! name: Echoes of Aether
lang: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
short: A hardcore indie action RPG exploring a post-purification world and uncovering the truth.
about: [ SHORT DESCRIPTION — 300 characters max ]  Arcas, the golden guardian, has fallen to the Code of Obedience. Fight through 15 procedurally generated regions in a single-player hack-and-slash ARPG. Chain skills, farm gear and materials, and break the same world again across 4 difficulties. No online, no microtransactions, no ads.  [ ABOUT THIS GAME ]  A World Where the Aether Is Fading  The Aether that held the world together has gone silent, and something called the Code of Obedience crawled into the space it left behind. Even Arcas, the golden guardian who once shielded humanity, was seized by the Code and twisted into the ruler of the abyss.  You begin alone in a broken village and climb back through fifteen regions to sever the Code at its root. What waits at the end is not just a final enemy — it is Arcas breaking his chains and ascending back into gold.  What Kind of Game Is This?  Echoes of Aether is a single-player isometric action RPG built around the classic hack-and-slash feel. Move with the mouse, dump skills with the Q, W, E, R  keys, wipe out a screen full of enemies, and pick up what they drop. That simple, dependable loop is the whole point, and it is pushed all the way to the end.  The Core Loop  Prepare in town — equip gear, sell surplus materials, refill potions, and pick your destination at the waypoint.  Enter the dungeon — explore a layout that is generated fresh for every region and fight what comes at you.  Complete objectives — clear out enemies, gather seal fragments, hunt a mid-boss; the goal changes region to region.  Kill the mid-boss and claim the seal key — the boss chamber will not open without it.  Bring down the boss — a dedicated cutscene plays and the next region unlocks.  Come back stronger — bosses respawn, so you can farm them as many times as you like.  Every Act Changes How You Progress  Fifteen regions, but not fifteen copies of the same dungeon. Each of the three acts is built differently.  Act 1 (Regions 1-5) — From the Field to the Boss Dungeon  Thin out the enemies in an open field and a mid-boss reveals itself. Put it down, and the sealed entrance to the boss dungeon opens.  Act 2 (Regions 6-10) — Search, Combat, Boss Chamber  Each region splits into three dungeons. You must first uncover hidden seal fragments in the search dungeon to unlock the combat dungeon, and only the key dropped by its mid-boss will open the boss chamber.  Act 3 (Regions 11-15) — Nobody Knows Where They Are  Outskirts, Core, Depths — three dungeons, and which one hides the mid-boss and which hides the final boss is randomized every time. You have to go find them yourself.  Character Progression  Levels and stats — kills and quests feed experience into your health, mana, and damage.  Tiered skill unlocks — new skills open up as you level: single-target strikes, wide-area detonations, cursor-targeted meteor-style abilities, and defensive or support options. Late-game skills cost serious mana, so the question becomes what to cast and when, not how fast you can spam.  Gear hunting — weapons, armor, and accessories drop across rarity tiers, and top-tier Legendary pieces genuinely reshape how your character performs.  Materials and rituals — every region drops its own materials, which you gather to perform the ritual that carries you forward. Leftovers can be sold in bulk with a quantity slider in a single click.  Scaling mana regeneration — regen is proportional to your maximum mana, so the stronger you get, the more freely you can commit to your big skills.  Challenge and Replay  Four difficulties — Easy, Normal, Nightmare, and Hell. Higher difficulties raise both enemy health and damage; from the middle of Normal onward, letting a pack surround you ends the run in seconds.  Respawning bosses — every cleared boss can be challenged again, so gear farming never dead-ends.  Smart repopulation — when a region's enemy count drops far enough, it refills. Hunting grounds never go hollow.  50 achievements — from your

name: Crossfall
lang: English, Russian
short: Crossfall is a cozy single-player top-down RPG with turn-based combat, developed by a solo creator. Explore a tile-based world, take part in dialogues, complete quests, craft items, go fishing, and gather herbs. Improve your skills and shape your own build.
about: Crossfall   A cozy single-player top-down RPG that I’m developing on my own. A large world (well, eventually), deep systems, and zero pay-to-win nonsense — just sit down and play.     Crossfall is a desktop turn-based RPG inspired by classic CRPGs, MMO-style progression systems, and cozy mini-games in the spirit of farming sims. You create a character, explore the world tile by tile, talk to its inhabitants, fight monsters, learn crafts, and uncover the story step by step. All of it works  fully offline  on your computer, with no internet connection, subscriptions, or anything like that required.  ⚔ Tactical Turn-Based Combat  Combat here is about decisions, not mindless clicking. Aim at specific parts of an enemy’s body: headshots hit harder, while strikes to the limbs deal less damage. Protect your own vulnerable spots and read your opponent, because they  adapt : hit the same place twice, and the enemy will start guarding it. Bleeding, poison, stun, and weakening effects tick down over rounds, turning every move into a small tactical puzzle.  ✨ Magic and Builds  Spells are divided into schools and learned through scrolls. Every character has their own magical mark — an affinity for a specific school: “native” magic costs less, while unfamiliar magic costs more. Equip up to seven spells at once and level each of them to mastery, reducing mana costs and cooldowns. Attack, defense, healing, debuffs — build your own playstyle.  🎒 Gear and Inventory  Eleven equipment slots and a quick-access belt for potions and food. Items come in different grades — from common to angelic and demonic — along with a durability system, convenient drag-and-drop controls, stack splitting, and multi-select. Weapons, armor, jewelry, consumables, materials, recipes, keys, chests with contents, and much more.  🔨 Crafting Across Four Disciplines  Alchemy, blacksmithing, cooking, and crafting. Recipes are unlocked through items, dialogues, and events, while especially curious players can  experiment  by throwing together random ingredients and discovering new recipes through trial and error. Craft items one by one or in batches, but remember: failure is always possible.  🎣 Mini-Games and Peaceful Activities  Fishing, herb gathering, and woodcutting are separate activities with their own mechanics. They are a source of resources, a way to catch your breath between battles, and another reason to improve your skills.  📈 Layered Progression  It is not only your character level that grows. Every activity — fishing, gathering, combat — has its own mastery level, granting meaningful bonuses: more loot, shorter cooldowns, a chance for double resources, bonus experience, and more. The  synergy  system rewards combinations of actions with additional effects. The longer you play, the stronger and more distinctive your character becomes.  🗺 A Living, Reactive World  Branching dialogues with conditions, choices, and consequences. Quests — standard, repeatable, and daily — with hidden objectives. Factions with a reputation system: your actions change how entire groups see you. Merchants have their own wallets and inventories that refresh over time. NPCs live their own lives, and some patrol their routes. Dungeons feature random encounters and rewards. Under the hood, everything is powered by an event system — the world reacts to what you do.  🏆 Achievements  A full achievement system with progress tracking and Steam integration.  About Development  Crossfall is made by one person — me. It is both terrifying and exciting. This is a passion project that is growing gradually, system by system. No paid loot boxes (well, technically there are chests, but not for real money), no “always online,” no race for your wallet — just an RPG that, I hope, feels good to come back to. Thank you for stopping by. Every review and every piece of feedback truly matters to me.

name: Trust Me, I Nailed It
lang: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Traditional Chinese, Russian
short: <Trust Me, I Nailed It> is a turn-based strategy game where you edit video clips to make a screwed up warrior into a monster-slaying legend. Edit, stitch, and fake your way to epic battle videos. Make every fight look like a glorious win.
about: The world wasn’t saved by the hero’s blade, but by the editor’s mouse cursor.  You are a dedicated video editor tasked with manipulating battle footage of a hopeless warrior who can’t clear a dungeon. Hired by a warrior with no skill but endless ego, you must produce flashy “clear videos” that make it look like a flawless victory.  Analyze pre-battle intel that reveals enemy attack patterns, then place the warrior’s limited action clips on a timeline to write a scenario where victory is inevitable.  Satisfy both the cheering townsfolk and the dopamine-addicted Demon Lord, complete a fake heroic legend in seven days, and save the world.     Design the Win Before the Battle Begins   In the video editor, enemy attack patterns and disruptive actions are provided as pre-recorded footage.  Before the battle begins, players preview the timeline to identify exactly when attacks will occur and plan their countermeasures accordingly.             Clip Editing   Design the warrior's movements by placing 「Move」,「Melee Attack」,「Ranged Attack」, and 「Block」 clips onto an 8-tick timeline.             Visual Effects (VFX)   The highlight of editing is post-processing! Instantly transform a simple walk into a Teleport, or turn a weak jab into a Critical Hit to overwhelm your enemies.  Running low on memory? Don’t worry! Meet optimization goals such as "Fill All Timeline Slots," "Land 2+ Effective Hits," or "No Damage Taken" to increase your available memory capacity.             A Story Told Through FAKE Clear Videos   Enjoy the stark contrast between the warrior’s shameless request emails and the hero-worshipping news that pops up on your desktop.  In reality, the so-called hero is always running away—but turning them into the savior of the world through a nerve-wracking con is entirely up to you.

name: Orendral: After the Sundering
lang: English
short: A single-player, offline MUD-style text RPG. Learn a class, explore rival cities and dangerous roads, solve quests, and recruit simulated adventurers for party raids. Play through a classic desktop client with aliases, hotkeys, and a searchable manual. Intentionally silent.
about: A MUD-style world. No server required. Orendral: After the Sundering is a single-player text RPG played by reading, typing commands, and finding your own way. Its classic desktop client opens onto a world of rival cities, dangerous roads, independent adventurers, and ruins whose owners are long gone. Make a life between expeditions Choose a race and class, learn abilities through lessons, improve your equipment, and decide whether a city or House deserves your allegiance. Follow their advancement stories, investigate smaller troubles along the roads, or spend an evening hunting and exploring. A searchable HELP manual and progressive quest hints are always available. Find your company The adventurers you meet are simulated characters, not other people online. Greet them, exchange messages, and recruit companions close to your circle. Class abilities, injuries, curatives, and finite resources matter to your party as well as to you. Learn to fight together Practise in the arena without risking experience, enter clearly marked high-circle contested regions, or lead a party into raid dungeons. Raids begin around circle 20 and grow into demanding expeditions with hostile encounters, readable boss mechanics, and equipment worth bringing home. Your client, your characters Set aliases, custom hotkeys, numpad movement, and automatic curing. Cycle local targets with Tab, consult the regional map, and keep the live terminal visible while browsing older messages. Maintain multiple characters with local saves and import/export. Please know before playing This is a keyboard-and-mouse, text-first game, not a graphical MMO. All other adventurers and party members are part of the local simulation. No game server, subscription, separate account, or live generative-AI service is required. Orendral is intentionally silent: it has no music, sound effects, or voice acting.

name: Beyond Shadowgate DLC
lang: English
short: The DLC for the game Beyond Shadowgate includes 60 page retro, Strategy Guide, Original Soundtrack (22 tunes), Prelude Beyond Shadowgate comic, and an 8-bit map of the World of Shadowgate! Note that this purchase is for the DLC only and not the game itself.
about: Overview   This is the DLC for the game Beyond Shadowgate!  It includes:   Retro Strategy Guide{/b] Did you love the old Nintendo Strategy Guides? Yes? If so, you'll love our 60 page Beyond Shadowgate guide! It features step-by-step instructions that will take you through the entire game! It also features a ton of information about the game, behind the scenes info and maps!   Original Soundtrack  Orie Falconer pays homage to the great Hiroyuki Masuno, the composer of the original Shadowgate NES score! Orie has created 22 compelling chip-tune tracks for your listening pleasure!   Prelude Beyond Shadowgate comic  Want to find out what brought our hero Del Thornburrow to the dungeons of Gwynenthell, the capital city of Kal Torlin? Well, you're in luck! This digital comic will take you on a wild journey that ultimately leads to the start of the Beyond Shadowgate game!   NES Shadowgate comic  We created this comic to support NES Shadowgate many moons ago! Go down memory lane with this digital retelling of the classic adventure!   Raven Comic  The heroine of the shelved Shadowgate Rising N64 game was given the comic treatment and never released! Enjoy this story of Raven and her sarcastic pal Yorick!   8-bit map of the World of Shadowgate  It wouldn't be a Shadowgate game without a map! This 8-bit map created by our game artist Jeff Canam will look great as a desktop wallpaper!   Info on the game!   Here's some info on the game that the DLC contents are based on...  The original design of the never-before seen point and click adventure is being brought to life after 30+ years in the vault -  Beyond Shadowgate!  This new PC game is being created by the designers of the original 8-bit hit Shadowgate and a leading 8-bit adventure studio!   With a world that is  over five times larger  than Shadowgate, Beyond Shadowgate captures the same look and feel as the 8-bit console version while including modern design sensibilities.  Since the memory and color palette limitations are removed, Beyond Shadowgate is a  much longer and vibrant game , with both retro and modern gameplay mechanics that give you the feel of the original! For players accustomed to the NES 8-bit version, the game features XInput controller support. The adventure is also completely playable by mouse and key binds.  Get ready for the  ultimate, official Shadowgate sequel !   Story   35 years have passed since Jair defeated the Warlock Lord in the caverns beneath the living castle, Shadowgate. In that time, the land of Kal Torlin prospered and the events of Shadowgate were forgotten. But once again  evil is stirring , scheming to bring the world to ruin.  In the dungeons of Gwynenthell, the capital city of Kal Torlin, a lowly Fenling by the name of  Del Thornburrow  awaits his fate. No stranger to a jail cell, Del soon frees himself from the dangers of the dungeon, only to begin a journey that will push him to the edge of his limits.  Lead Del as he travels through Gwynenthell, across the Torlin Forest, over the Gatekeeper Mountains, and  beyond ! Uncover plots to overthrow kingdoms that threaten to plunge the land into darkness! Interact with old friends and new, while protecting Del from the traps, hazards, monsters, and every other peril that may introduce him to the ever-present Grim Reaper.   Features   By the Numbers…    250+ Rooms of adventure!   180+ Different ways to die!   150+ Objects in which to interact!   100+ Puzzles to solve!   20+ NPCs inhabit the lands!   3+ Game Endings to experience!    Also featuring…     A Side Quest based on Déjà vu: A Nightmare Comes True!   A Side Quest based on The Uninvited!   A Side Quest based on Shadowgate VR: The Mines of Mythrok!   Controller & mouse and keyboard!   A brand new Hint System!   A Quick Travel Map!   Lethal Puzzle Events!   Day/Night Progression!   A Death Indicator!

name: Mirrorscape
lang: English
short: Mirrorscape is bringing the table back to virtual tabletops! Build and play around the table or around the world using authentic 3D terrain, miniatures, and dice from top companies you know and love. Cross-play on iOS and Android devices using the magic of augmented reality!
about: Mirrorscape: Immersive Tabletop Gaming Redefined     Introducing Mirrorscape, the free-to-play app that delivers an immersive and authentic tabletop gaming experience on PC, Mac, iOS and Android.   Built for Dungeon Masters (DMs) and players alike, Mirrorscape offers an intuitive and easy-to-use, authentic 3D environment for building and playing your favorite tabletop role-playing and war games.     "Mirrorscape uses AR to create what might be the best D&D virtual tabletop yet"  - GamesRadar+    "It's easy to get excited about the augmented tabletop, for how it might further revitalize tabletop gaming.”  - Wired    "The promise of living characters and armies battling on the tables before us, across atmospheric and immersive worlds, is arguably too cool to second guess."  - Wargamer      Free Starter Set and Trial    Mirrorscape is free-to-play, and every player receives a Free Starter Set of terrain, miniatures, and dice from renowned brands in the tabletop world, including Dwarven Forge, Reaper Minis, Fat Dragon Games, TitanCraft Custom Minis and Hero Forge. Claim a bonus of 5 free Hero Forge minis when you link your Hero Forge account.  Additionally, to enhance your creativity and world-building abilities Mirrorscape offers a 30-Day Free Trial of everything in the Mirrorscape Store.        Intuitive World-Building   Building has never been easier thanks to Mirrorscapes’s intuitive drag-and-drop stacking, snap points, copy, paste and group functionality and use of clipping planes for multi-level construction of mighty castles, simple taverns and deep, dark dungeons. Bring light to your creations with lit terrain and prop lights. DMs and GMs can easily create intricately detailed adventure maps to be shared with their players and streamed on platforms like Twitch and YouTube. Or, for the “Lazy GM”, grab a pre-built map made by our vibrant user community that fits your campaign or share your own creations on the Mirrorscape Hub!     Authentic Digital Twins for Terrain, Minis, Props and Dice From Famous Tabletop Brands   To create the adventure map of your dreams Mirrorscape boasts a vast collection of fully painted digital twins of terrain, miniatures, props, and dice from famous brands you already know and love including Fat Dragon Games, Dwarven Forge, Reaper Minis, and Norse Foundry.  Each item is meticulously crafted to be an authentic replica of the original physical item for an unparalleled level of realism. Digital replicas of real-world dice bounce in the virtual world just like they do on your table.             Dungeon Master Tools to Share and Manage the Adventure    Mirrorscape equips DMs with a comprehensive suite of Dungeon Master Tools to manage game night and craft unforgettable gaming experiences. Once your world is complete, share it with your players for free, then use features like hide and reveal for “fog of war” effects, ambient lighting to set the mood, beacons to draw player’s attention, and line of sight and measurement tools to ensure a seamless and engaging gameplay experience. The built-in Mirrorscape HUB streamlines game scheduling, keeping your adventures organized and accessible while helping players find games and Games Masters find players.                Immersive Player Experience with Character Point-Of-View    Players of role-playing tabletop games and tabletop wargames can choose from a deep collection of beautifully painted miniatures to represent their characters and immerse themselves in their virtual worlds by dropping into their character’s point-of-view.  Connect your Hero Forge account and drop your custom minis on the table for even more options! Roll digital dice, inhabit the world from a first-person perspective, check line of sight and bring your adventure to life like never before! name: Glyph Gambit
lang: English**
short: A turn-based tactical roguelite where you battle across grid-based arenas, destroy the enemy King before they destroy yours, and protect your Glyphs—lost if you fall, recoverable only by clearing the level where they dropped.
about: ABOUT THIS GAME    Glyph Gambit  is a turn-based tactical roguelite inspired by chess, Dark Souls, and grid-based dungeon crawlers. Each run challenges you to navigate dangerous tactical arenas where every move matters and every decision can end your journey. Your objective is clear:   Destroy the enemy King before they destroy yours.   You control multiple upgradable pieces on compact battle grids, facing distinct enemy factions with their own movement patterns and threats. Equip offensive  Edges , defensive  Shields , and powerful  Gems  and  Items  to shape your build and survive deeper into the gauntlet.  At the heart of the game are  Glyphs —the soul of your run. Glyphs empower your piece, unlock new abilities, and fuel long-term progression. But they are fragile. If you fall in battle, your Glyphs drop on that level. To reclaim them, you must return to that same encounter and clear it. Fail again before recovery, and those Glyphs are lost forever.   Tactical Combat on Compact Grids   Fight on small, focused encounter boards where positioning is everything. Predict enemy intent, manage danger zones, and outmaneuver rival Kings. Every run presents new tactical puzzles that reward smart planning and bold plays.   A Souls-Inspired Challenge Loop   Death resets the run—but permanent upgrades, unlocked items, and new Glyphs progressively expand your options. Each attempt pushes you further as you refine your strategy and piece loadout.   Distinct Enemy Factions & Bosses   Face Goblin raiders, Sage spellcasters, Usurpers, Plague creatures, Warlords, and ancient Tyrant bosses—each with unique attack shapes and movement patterns that challenge you to adapt and survive.   Build Your Piece With Permanent Items   Equip a wide range of upgrades including:     Edges  – Offensive stat boosts     Shields  – Defensive enhancements     Gems  – For upgrading edges and shields     Glyphs  – The soul of the game for leveling up and purchasing items     Permanent Items   - Items that can be used across all runs     Run Items    - Items that can be used for one run     Level Items  - Items that can be used for one level in a run     Consumables  - Items that are applied and consumed immediately     Designed for Controllers & Steam Deck   Featuring full controller support and clean UI navigation, Glyph Gambit plays naturally on both desktop and Steam Deck.   FEATURES     Turn-based tactical battles on compact grid arenas    Roguelite runs with permanent progression and unlocks    Core objective: destroy their King before they destroy yours    Glyphs that drop on death and can be lost forever    Dozens of Edges, Shields, and Gems to shape your build    Procedural encounters and branching run paths    Distinct factions with unique patterns and bosses    Souls-like atmosphere and challenge    Full controller support and Steam Deck compatible    Highly replayable with deep strategic choices
